sentences.zh: 志第三十五 禮十三

translations.literal: Treatise 35, Rites 13
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 35: Rites, Part Thirteen

sentences.zh: （凶禮二）〉

translations.literal: (Mourning Rites 2)
translations.idiomatic: (Mourning Rites, Part Two)

sentences.zh: 皇后陵寢 興宗帝后陵寢 睿宗帝后陵寢 皇妃等喪葬 皇太子及妃喪葬諸王及妃公主喪葬

translations.literal: Empress mausoleums; mausoleums of the Xingzong Emperor and consort; mausoleums of the Ruizong Emperor and consort; funerals of imperial consorts and the like; funerals of the crown prince and consort; funerals of princes and consorts; funerals of princesses
translations.idiomatic: Empress mausoleums; mausoleums of Emperor Xingzong and his consort; mausoleums of Emperor Ruizong and his consort; funerals of imperial consorts and the like; funerals of the crown prince and his consort; funerals of princes and consorts; funerals of princesses

sentences.zh: ○皇后陵寢

translations.literal: ○ Empress Mausoleums
translations.idiomatic: ○ Empress Mausoleums

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年，皇后馬氏崩。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, Empress Ma died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of the Hongwu reign, Empress Ma died.

sentences.zh: 禮部引宋製爲請。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites cited Song regulations in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites cited Song-dynasty regulations in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 於是命在京文武官及聽除官，人給布一匹，令自制服，皆斬衰二十七日而除，服素服百日。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was ordered that each civil and military official in the capital, as well as officials awaiting assignment, was given one bolt of cloth to make their own garments; all wore cut-edge hemp mourning for twenty-seven days then dismissed it, and wore plain dress for one hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the court ordered that every civil and military official in the capital, including those awaiting appointment, receive one bolt of cloth to make mourning garments themselves; all were to wear cut-edge hemp mourning for twenty-seven days before laying it aside, then plain dress for one hundred days.

sentences.zh: 凡在京官，越三日素服至右順門外，具喪服入臨畢，素服行奉慰禮，三日而止。

translations.literal: All officials in the capital, after three days in plain dress, came in plain dress to outside the Right Shun Gate, put on full mourning to enter and attend the lying-in-state, then in plain dress performed the consolation rite, for three days only.
translations.idiomatic: All officials in the capital, after three days in plain mourning dress, came to the area outside the Right Shun Gate; they then donned full mourning to enter and attend the lying-in-state, and afterward in plain dress performed the consolation rite for three days.

sentences.zh: 武官五品以上、文官三品以上命婦，亦於第四日素服至乾清宮入臨。

translations.literal: Wives of officials of fifth rank and above in the military, and third rank and above in the civil service, also on the fourth day came in plain dress to the Palace of Heavenly Purity to attend the lying-in-state.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day, titled wives of military officials of the fifth rank and above and civil officials of the third rank and above likewise came in plain dress to the Palace of Heavenly Purity to attend the lying-in-state.

sentences.zh: 用麻布蓋頭，麻布衫裙鞋，去首飾脂粉。

translations.literal: They used hemp cloth head coverings, hemp cloth shirts, skirts, and shoes, and removed head ornaments and cosmetics.
translations.idiomatic: They wore hemp-cloth head coverings and hemp shirts, skirts, and shoes, and laid aside all head ornaments and cosmetics.

sentences.zh: 其外官服制與京官同。

translations.literal: Mourning dress for officials outside the capital was the same as for capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: Officials outside the capital followed the same mourning dress as those in the capital.

sentences.zh: 聞訃日於公廳成服，命婦服亦與在京命婦同，皆三日而除。

translations.literal: On the day word of the death arrived, they assumed mourning at the government hall; titled wives' dress was also the same as for titled wives in the capital, all dismissed after three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the day the death was announced, they assumed mourning at their government offices; titled wives wore the same dress as their counterparts in the capital, and all laid mourning aside after three days.

sentences.zh: 軍民男女素服三日。

translations.literal: Soldiers and commoners, men and women, wore plain dress for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and commoners of both sexes wore plain mourning dress for three days.

sentences.zh: 禁屠宰，在京四十九日，在外三日。

translations.literal: Slaughter was forbidden: forty-nine days in the capital, three days outside.
translations.idiomatic: Slaughter was prohibited for forty-nine days in the capital and three days elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 停音樂祭祀百日。

translations.literal: Music and sacrifices were suspended for one hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: Music and sacrifices were suspended for one hundred days.

sentences.zh: 嫁娶，官停百日，軍民一月。

translations.literal: Marriages: officials suspended for one hundred days, soldiers and commoners for one month.
translations.idiomatic: Marriages were suspended for one hundred days among officials and one month among soldiers and commoners.

sentences.zh: 將發引，告太廟，遣官祭金水橋、午門等神及鐘山之神。

translations.literal: When the coffin was about to be escorted forth, the Ancestral Temple was notified, and officials were dispatched to sacrifice to the spirits at the Golden Water Bridge, Meridian Gate, and other deities, and to the spirit of Mount Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Before the coffin was escorted forth, the court notified the Ancestral Temple and dispatched officials to sacrifice to the spirits at the Golden Water Bridge, the Meridian Gate, and other sites, as well as to the spirit of Mount Zhong.

sentences.zh: 帝親祭於几筵，百官喪服詣朝陽門外奉辭。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally sacrificed at the spirit table; officials in mourning dress went to outside the Chaoyang Gate to perform the farewell rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sacrificed in person at the spirit table, while officials in mourning dress went outside the Chaoyang Gate to perform the farewell rite.

sentences.zh: 是日，安厝皇堂。

translations.literal: That day, the remains were laid to rest in the imperial hall.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the remains were laid to rest in the imperial hall.

sentences.zh: 皇太子奠，玄纁玉璧，行奉辭禮。

translations.literal: The crown prince offered libation with a dark-red jade disk and performed the farewell rite.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince offered libation with a dark-red jade disk and performed the farewell rite.

sentences.zh: 神主還宮，百官素服迎於朝陽門外，仍行奉慰禮。

translations.literal: The spirit tablet returned to the palace; officials in plain dress welcomed it outside the Chaoyang Gate and again performed the consolation rite.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit tablet returned to the palace, officials in plain dress welcomed it outside the Chaoyang Gate and again performed the consolation rite.

sentences.zh: 帝復以醴饌祭於几筵殿，自再虞至九虞，皆如之。

translations.literal: The Emperor again sacrificed with ritual food and drink at the Spirit Table Hall; from the second yu through the ninth yu, all were the same.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again offered ritual food and drink at the Spirit Table Hall, and did the same from the second through the ninth yu sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 遣官告謝鐘山之神。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to announce thanks to the spirit of Mount Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to announce thanks to the spirit of Mount Zhong.

sentences.zh: 卒哭，以神主詣廟行祔享禮。

translations.literal: At the end of wailing, the spirit tablet was taken to the temple to perform the collateral installation and offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of wailing, the spirit tablet was taken to the temple for the collateral installation and offering rite.

sentences.zh: 喪滿百日，帝輟朝，祭几筵殿，致欽不拜。

translations.literal: When mourning reached one hundred days, the Emperor suspended court, sacrificed at the Spirit Table Hall, and offered reverence without bowing.
translations.idiomatic: When the mourning period reached one hundred days, the emperor suspended court, sacrificed at the Spirit Table Hall, and offered reverence without performing a bow.

sentences.zh: 東宮以下奠帛爵，百官素服行奉慰禮。

translations.literal: Those below the Eastern Palace offered silk and libation cups; officials in plain dress performed the consolation rite.
translations.idiomatic: Members of the Eastern Palace and below offered silk and libation cups, while officials in plain dress performed the consolation rite.

sentences.zh: 東宮、親王、妃、主以牲醴祭孝陵，公侯等從。

translations.literal: The Eastern Palace, princes, consorts, and princesses sacrificed with victims and ritual wine at Xiaoling, with dukes and marquises following.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace, princes, consorts, and princesses sacrificed with victims and ritual wine at the Xiaoling mausoleum, accompanied by dukes and marquises.

sentences.zh: 命婦詣几筵殿祭奠。

translations.literal: Titled wives went to the Spirit Table Hall to offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Titled wives went to the Spirit Table Hall to offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 自後凡節序及忌日，東宮親王祭几筵及陵。

translations.literal: Thereafter, on every seasonal festival and death anniversary, the Eastern Palace and princes sacrificed at the spirit table and mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, on every seasonal festival and death anniversary, the Eastern Palace and princes sacrificed at the spirit table and the mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 小祥，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: At the first-year mourning anniversary, court was suspended for three days.
translations.idiomatic: At the first-year mourning anniversary, court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 禁在京音樂屠宰，設醮於靈谷寺、朝天宮各三日。

translations.literal: Music and slaughter were forbidden in the capital; fasting rites were held at Linggu Temple and Chaotian Palace for three days each.
translations.idiomatic: Music and slaughter were forbidden in the capital, and fasting rites were held for three days each at Linggu Temple and Chaotian Palace.

sentences.zh: 帝率皇太子以下詣几筵殿祭。

translations.literal: The Emperor led the crown prince and those below to the Spirit Table Hall to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor led the crown prince and those below to the Spirit Table Hall to sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 百官素服，詣宮門。

translations.literal: Officials in plain dress went to the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Officials in plain dress went to the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 進香訖，詣後右門奉慰。

translations.literal: After presenting incense, they went to the Rear Right Gate to perform consolation.
translations.idiomatic: After presenting incense, they went to the Rear Right Gate to perform the consolation rite.

sentences.zh: 外命婦詣几筵殿進香。

translations.literal: Titled wives from outside the capital went to the Spirit Table Hall to present incense.
translations.idiomatic: Titled wives from outside the capital went to the Spirit Table Hall to present incense.

sentences.zh: 皇太子、親王熟布練冠九衤取，皇孫七衤取，皆去首絰。

translations.literal: The crown prince and princes wore processed-cloth bleached caps of nine panels; imperial grandsons wore seven panels; all removed the head mourning band.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince and princes wore nine-panel processed-cloth bleached caps; imperial grandsons wore seven-panel caps; all removed the head mourning band.

sentences.zh: 負版闢領衰。

translations.literal: They bore tablets on the back and wore slit-collar hemp mourning.
translations.idiomatic: They bore mourning tablets on the back and wore slit-collar hemp mourning.

sentences.zh: 見帝及百官則素服、烏紗帽、烏犀帶。

translations.literal: When seeing the Emperor and officials they wore plain dress, black gauze caps, and black rhinoceros-horn belts.
translations.idiomatic: When appearing before the emperor and officials they wore plain dress, black gauze caps, and black rhinoceros-horn belts.

sentences.zh: 妃、主以下，熟布蓋頭，去腰絰。

translations.literal: Consorts, princesses, and those below wore processed-cloth head coverings and removed waist mourning bands.
translations.idiomatic: Consorts, princesses, and those of lower rank wore processed-cloth head coverings and removed their waist mourning bands.

sentences.zh: 宗室駙馬練冠，去首絰。

translations.literal: Imperial clansmen and imperial sons-in-law wore bleached caps and removed head mourning bands.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansmen and imperial sons-in-law wore bleached hemp caps and removed their head mourning bands.

sentences.zh: 內尚衣、尚冠，以所釋服於几筵殿前丙位焚之。

translations.literal: The Inner Director of Vestments and Director of Caps burned the garments that had been laid aside at the south position before the Spirit Table Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The directors of inner vestments and caps burned the garments that had been laid aside at the south position before the Spirit Table Hall.

sentences.zh: 皇太子、親王復詣陵行禮。

translations.literal: The crown prince and princes again went to the mausoleum to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince and princes again went to the mausoleum to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 大祥，奉安神主於奉先殿，預期齋戒告廟。

translations.literal: At the second-year mourning anniversary, the spirit tablet was installed in the Hall of Forefathers; beforehand fasting and purification were observed and the temple was notified.
translations.idiomatic: At the second-year mourning anniversary, the spirit tablet was installed in the Hall of Forefathers, after advance fasting and notification of the temple.

sentences.zh: 百官陪祀畢，行奉慰禮。

translations.literal: After officials had completed accompanying the sacrifice, they performed the consolation rite.
translations.idiomatic: After officials had completed accompanying the sacrifice, they performed the consolation rite.

sentences.zh: 成祖皇后徐氏崩，自次日輟朝，不鳴鐘鼓。

translations.literal: Empress Xu, consort of the Chengzu Emperor, died; from the next day court was suspended and bells and drums were not sounded.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Xu, consort of the Chengzu Emperor, died, court was suspended from the following day and bells and drums were not sounded.

sentences.zh: 帝素服御西角門，百官素服詣思善門外哭臨畢，行奉慰禮。

translations.literal: The Emperor in plain dress presided at the West Corner Gate; officials in plain dress went to outside the Gate of Cherishing Goodness to wail and attend the lying-in-state, then performed the consolation rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, in plain dress, presided at the West Corner Gate; officials in plain dress went outside the Gate of Cherishing Goodness to wail and attend the lying-in-state, then performed the consolation rite.

sentences.zh: 三日成服，哭臨如上儀。

translations.literal: On the third day full mourning was assumed; wailing and attendance followed the above protocol.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day they assumed full mourning, and wailing and attendance followed the protocol above.

sentences.zh: 自次日爲始，各就公署齋宿，二十七日止。

translations.literal: From the next day onward, each took lodging in fasting at his government office for twenty-seven days.
translations.idiomatic: From the following day onward, each official lodged in fasting at his government office for twenty-seven days.

sentences.zh: 文武四品以上命婦成服日爲始，詣思善門內哭臨三日。

translations.literal: From the day titled wives of civil and military officials of the fourth rank and above assumed mourning, they went inside the Gate of Cherishing Goodness to wail and attend for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Starting on the day titled wives of civil and military officials of the fourth rank and above assumed mourning, they went inside the Gate of Cherishing Goodness to wail and attend for three days.

sentences.zh: 聽選辦事官，俱喪服。

translations.literal: Officials awaiting selection who handled affairs all wore mourning dress.
translations.idiomatic: Officials awaiting selection who were handling affairs all wore mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 人材監生、吏典、僧道、坊廂耆老各素服。

translations.literal: Students of the Talent Directorate, clerks, monks and Daoists, and ward elders each wore plain dress.
translations.idiomatic: Students of the Talent Directorate, clerks, monks and Daoist priests, and ward elders each wore plain dress.

sentences.zh: 自成服日始，赴應天府舉哀三日，餘悉遵高後時儀。

translations.literal: From the day full mourning was assumed, they went to Shuntian Prefecture to raise lamentation for three days; the rest all followed the protocol of Empress Gao's time.
translations.idiomatic: From the day full mourning was assumed, they went to Shuntian Prefecture to raise lamentation for three days; everything else followed the protocol used at the death of Empress Ma.

sentences.zh: 又定諸王、公主等服制，世子郡王皆齊衰不杖期。

translations.literal: Mourning dress for princes, princesses, and the like was also fixed: heir apparent and commandery princes all wore hemmed hemp without staff for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning dress for princes, princesses, and the like was also fixed: heirs apparent and commandery princes all wore hemmed hemp mourning without a staff for one year.

sentences.zh: 世子郡王妃、郡主皆大功。

translations.literal: Heirs' consorts and commandery princesses all wore greater hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Consorts of heirs apparent and commandery princesses all wore greater hemp mourning.

sentences.zh: 周、楚諸王及寧國諸公主及郡王之子皆小功。

translations.literal: Princes of Zhou, Chu, and the like, princesses of Ning, and sons of commandery princes all wore lesser hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Princes of Zhou, Chu, and the like, princesses of Ning, and sons of commandery princes all wore lesser hemp mourning.

sentences.zh: 遣中官訃告諸王府，造祔裏，謁太廟。

translations.literal: Palace eunuchs were dispatched to announce the death to the various princely establishments; collateral-installation garments were made and the Ancestral Temple was visited.
translations.idiomatic: Palace eunuchs were dispatched to announce the death to the various princely establishments; garments for collateral installation were prepared and the Ancestral Temple was visited.

sentences.zh: 祭器、諡冊、諡寶悉用檀香。

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels, posthumous-name registers, and posthumous-name seals were all made of sandalwood.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels, posthumous-name registers, and posthumous-name seals were all made of sandalwood.

sentences.zh: 將冊，帝躬告天地於奉天殿丹陛上。

translations.literal: When the posthumous name was about to be conferred, the Emperor personally announced to Heaven and Earth on the cinnabar steps of the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: When the posthumous name was about to be conferred, the emperor personally announced to Heaven and Earth on the cinnabar steps of the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 御華蓋殿，鴻臚寺官引頒冊寶官入行禮，傳制曰：「永樂五年十月十四日，冊諡大行皇后，命卿行禮。

translations.literal: He presided at the Canopy Hall; an official of the Court of State Ceremonial led the officials conferring the register and seal to enter and perform the rite, and the decree was proclaimed: "On the fourteenth day of the tenth month of the fifth year of Yongle, confer the posthumous name on the late empress; I command you, sir, to perform the rite."
translations.idiomatic: He presided at the Canopy Hall; an official of the Court of State Ceremonial led the officials who were to confer the register and seal into the hall to perform the rite, and the decree was proclaimed: "On the fourteenth day of the tenth month of the fifth year of Yongle, confer the posthumous name on the late empress; I command you, sir, to perform the rite."

sentences.zh: 」四拜畢，序班舉冊寶案至奉天殿丹陛上，置彩輿中，由中道出，入右順門至几筵殿，以冊寶置案，退俟於殿外。

translations.literal: " After four bows were completed, the orderlies raised the register-and-seal table to the cinnabar steps of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, placed it in the colored palanquin, went out by the central avenue, entered the Right Shun Gate to the Spirit Table Hall, placed the register and seal on the table, and withdrew to wait outside the hall.
translations.idiomatic: After four bows were completed, the orderlies raised the register-and-seal table to the cinnabar steps of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, placed it in the colored palanquin, went out by the central avenue, entered the Right Shun Gate to the Spirit Table Hall, set the register and seal on the table, and withdrew to wait outside the hall.

sentences.zh: 尚儀女官詣香案前，跪進曰：「皇帝遣某官冊諡大行皇后，謹告。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies, a female official, went before the incense table, knelt, and presented the words: "The Emperor has dispatched a certain official to confer the posthumous name on the late empress; I respectfully announce this."
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies, a female official, went before the incense table, knelt, and announced: "The emperor has dispatched a certain official to confer the posthumous name on the late empress; I respectfully announce this."

sentences.zh: 」贊宣冊，女官捧冊宣於几筵之右，置冊於案，宣寶如之。

translations.literal: " The usher praised the proclamation of the register; a female official bore the register and proclaimed it to the right of the spirit table, placed the register on the table, and proclaimed the seal in the same way.
translations.idiomatic: The usher prompted the proclamation of the register; a female official bore the register and proclaimed it to the right of the spirit table, placed the register on the table, and proclaimed the seal in the same way.

sentences.zh: 尚儀奏禮畢，女官以冊寶案置几筵之左。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies reported that the rite was complete; a female official placed the register-and-seal table to the left of the spirit table.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies reported that the rite was complete; a female official placed the register-and-seal table to the left of the spirit table.

sentences.zh: 內官出報禮畢，頒冊寶官覆命。

translations.literal: An inner eunuch came out to report that the rite was complete, and the officials who had conferred the register and seal reported back.
translations.idiomatic: An inner eunuch came out to report that the rite was complete, and the officials who had conferred the register and seal reported back to the throne.

sentences.zh: 百日，禮部請御正門視朝，鳴鐘鼓，百官易淺淡色服。

translations.literal: At one hundred days, the Ministry of Rites requested that the Emperor hold court at the Main Gate, sound bells and drums, and that officials change to pale-colored dress.
translations.idiomatic: At the hundred-day mark, the Ministry of Rites requested that the emperor hold court at the Main Gate, sound bells and drums, and that officials change to pale-colored dress.

sentences.zh: 帝以梓宮未葬，不允。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because the coffin had not yet been buried, did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not grant the request, because the coffin had not yet been buried.

sentences.zh: 至週期，帝素服詣几筵致祭，百官西角門奉慰，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: When the anniversary arrived, the Emperor in plain dress went to the spirit table to sacrifice; officials performed consolation at the West Corner Gate; court was suspended for three days.
translations.idiomatic: When the anniversary arrived, the emperor in plain dress went to the spirit table to sacrifice; officials performed the consolation rite at the West Corner Gate; and court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 在京停音樂、禁屠宰七日。

translations.literal: In the capital music was stopped and slaughter forbidden for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital, music was stopped and slaughter forbidden for seven days.

sentences.zh: 禮部官於天禧寺、朝天宮齋醮。

translations.literal: Officials of the Ministry of Rites performed fasting rites at Tianxi Temple and Chaotian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Ministry of Rites performed fasting rites at Tianxi Temple and Chaotian Palace.

sentences.zh: 其明日，帝吉服御奉天門視朝，鳴鐘鼓。

translations.literal: The next day, the Emperor in auspicious dress presided at the Gate of Supreme Harmony to hold court; bells and drums were sounded.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the emperor, in auspicious dress, held court at the Gate of Supreme Harmony, and bells and drums were sounded.

sentences.zh: 百官服淺淡色衣、烏紗帽、黑角帶，退朝署事仍素服。

translations.literal: Officials wore pale-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts; after court they still wore plain dress when handling affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Officials wore pale-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts; after court they still wore plain dress when handling affairs at their offices.

sentences.zh: 遇朔望，朝見慶賀如常儀。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of the month, audiences and congratulations followed the usual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of the month, audiences and congratulations followed the usual protocol.

sentences.zh: 几筵祭祀，熟布練冠。

translations.literal: For spirit-table sacrifices, processed-cloth bleached caps were worn.
translations.idiomatic: For spirit-table sacrifices, processed-cloth bleached caps were worn.

sentences.zh: 及發引，齋三日，遣官以葬期告郊廟社稷。

translations.literal: When the coffin was escorted forth, fasting was observed for three days, and officials were dispatched to announce the burial date to the suburban altars, temples, and altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin was escorted forth, the court observed three days of fasting and dispatched officials to announce the burial date to the suburban altars, temples, and altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 帝素服祭告几筵，皇太子以下衰服行禮，遣官祭所過橋門及沿途祀典諸神。

translations.literal: The Emperor in plain dress sacrificed and announced at the spirit table; the crown prince and those below in hemp mourning performed the rites; officials were dispatched to sacrifice at bridges and gates passed and to deities along the route enshrined in canonical worship.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in plain dress sacrificed and announced at the spirit table; the crown prince and those below, in hemp mourning, performed the rites; and officials were dispatched to sacrifice at every bridge and gate along the route and to the deities enshrined along the way.

sentences.zh: 百官及命婦俱素服，以次路祭。

translations.literal: Officials and titled wives all wore plain dress and in turn performed roadside sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and titled wives all wore plain dress and performed roadside sacrifices in turn.

sentences.zh: 梓宮至江濱，百官奉辭於江濱。

translations.literal: When the coffin reached the riverbank, officials performed the farewell rite at the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin reached the riverbank, officials performed the farewell rite there.

sentences.zh: 皇太子送渡江，漢王護行，途中朝夕哭奠。

translations.literal: The crown prince escorted it across the river; the Prince of Han guarded the procession; morning and evening along the way they wailed and offered libation.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince escorted the coffin across the river; the Prince of Han guarded the procession; and morning and evening along the way they wailed and offered libation.

sentences.zh: 官民迎祭者，皆素服。

translations.literal: Officials and commoners who came to welcome and sacrifice all wore plain dress.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and commoners who came to welcome the procession and offer sacrifice all wore plain dress.

sentences.zh: 既葬，賜護送官軍及舁梓官軍士鈔米有差。

translations.literal: After burial, paper money and grain were bestowed in differing amounts on the escort troops and the soldiers who had borne the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: After the burial, paper money and grain were bestowed in differing amounts on the escort troops and the soldiers who had borne the coffin.

sentences.zh: 正統中，仁宗皇后張氏崩，禮部定大行太皇太后喪禮。

translations.literal: In the Zhengtong reign, Empress Zhang, consort of Renzong, died; the Ministry of Rites fixed the mourning rites for the late grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengtong reign, Empress Zhang, consort of Emperor Renzong, died; the Ministry of Rites fixed the mourning rites for the late grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 皇帝成服三日後，即聽政。

translations.literal: Three days after the Emperor assumed full mourning, he immediately attended to government.
translations.idiomatic: Three days after the emperor assumed full mourning, he immediately resumed attending to government.

sentences.zh: 祀典皆勿廢，諸王以下內外各官及命婦哭臨如前儀，衰服二十七日而除，軍民男女素服十三日。

translations.literal: Canonical sacrifices were none of them abolished; princes and all officials inside and outside the capital and titled wives wailed and attended as in the previous protocol; hemp mourning was dismissed after twenty-seven days; soldiers and commoners, men and women, wore plain dress for thirteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Canonical sacrifices were not suspended; princes and all officials inside and outside the capital, together with titled wives, wailed and attended as in the previous protocol; hemp mourning was laid aside after twenty-seven days; and soldiers and commoners of both sexes wore plain dress for thirteen days.

sentences.zh: 諸王勿會葬，外官勿進香，臣民勿禁音樂嫁娶。

translations.literal: Princes did not attend the burial; outside officials did not present incense; subjects were not forbidden music or marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Princes did not attend the burial; officials outside the capital did not present incense; and subjects were not forbidden music or marriage.

sentences.zh: 及葬，遣官告太廟。

translations.literal: At burial, officials were dispatched to announce to the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: At the burial, officials were dispatched to announce the event to the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 帝親奉太后衣冠謁列祖帝、後及仁宗神位，又奉宣宗衣冠謁太后神位，其禮視時享。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally bore the grand empress dowager's garments and cap to visit the spirit tablets of successive ancestral emperors and empresses and Renzong's tablet, and again bore Xuanzong's garments and cap to visit the grand empress dowager's tablet; the rite followed the seasonal offering.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally bore the grand empress dowager's garments and cap to visit the spirit tablets of successive ancestral emperors and empresses and that of Emperor Renzong, and again bore Emperor Xuanzong's garments and cap to visit the grand empress dowager's tablet; the rite followed that of the seasonal offering.

sentences.zh: 天順中，宣帝皇后孫氏崩，儀如故事，止改哭臨於清寧門。

translations.literal: In the Tianshun reign, Empress Sun, consort of the Xuandi Emperor, died; the protocol followed precedent, only changing wailing and attendance to the Gate of Pure Tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianshun reign, Empress Sun, consort of Emperor Xuandi, died; the protocol followed precedent, changing only the place of wailing and attendance to the Gate of Pure Tranquility.

sentences.zh: 英宗皇后錢氏崩，禮如舊，惟屠宰止禁七日，外國使臣免哭臨。

translations.literal: Empress Qian, consort of Yingzong, died; the rites were as before, only slaughter was forbidden for seven days, and foreign envoys were exempt from wailing and attendance.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Qian, consort of Emperor Yingzong, died, the rites followed the old practice, except that slaughter was forbidden for only seven days and foreign envoys were exempt from wailing and attendance.

sentences.zh: 正德元年，景帝后汪氏薨。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengde, Lady Wang, consort of the Jingdi Emperor, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Zhengde reign, Lady Wang, consort of Emperor Jingdi, died.

sentences.zh: 禮部會羣臣言，宜如皇妃例，輟朝三日，祭九壇。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites convened the assembled ministers, who said it should follow the precedent for an imperial consort: court suspended for three days and nine altars of sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites convened the assembled ministers, who said the rites should follow the precedent for an imperial consort: court suspended for three days and sacrifices at nine altars.

sentences.zh: 太后、中宮、親王以下文武大臣命婦皆有祭。

translations.literal: The empress dowager, the central palace, princes, and civil and military grand ministers and titled wives all had sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager, the empress, princes, and civil and military grand ministers and titled wives all offered sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The decree approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The decree approved it.

sentences.zh: 憲宗廢后吳氏，正德四年薨，以大學士李東陽等言，禮如英宗惠妃故事。

translations.literal: The deposed empress Wu of Xianzong died in the fourth year of Zhengde; on the words of Grand Secretary Li Dongyang and others, the rites followed the precedent of Yingzong's Consort Hui.
translations.idiomatic: The deposed empress Wu of Emperor Xianzong died in the fourth year of Zhengde; on the recommendation of Grand Secretary Li Dongyang and others, the rites followed the precedent set at the death of Consort Hui of Emperor Yingzong.

sentences.zh: 憲宗皇后王氏，正德十三年崩。

translations.literal: Empress Wang, consort of Xianzong, died in the thirteenth year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wang, consort of Emperor Xianzong, died in the thirteenth year of the Zhengde reign.

sentences.zh: 越三日，帝至自宣府，乃發喪。

translations.literal: After three days the Emperor arrived from Xuanfu, and only then was mourning proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later the emperor returned from Xuanfu, and only then was mourning proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 百官具素服，於清寧宮門外聽宣遺誥。

translations.literal: Officials prepared plain dress and outside the Gate of the Palace of Pure Tranquility listened to the proclamation of the final testament.
translations.idiomatic: Officials prepared plain dress and, outside the Gate of the Palace of Pure Tranquility, listened to the proclamation of the final testament.

sentences.zh: 及發引，先期結平臺，與順天府交衢相值。

translations.literal: When the coffin was escorted forth, a level platform was built in advance, meeting the crossroads of Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin was escorted forth, a level platform was built in advance at the crossroads of Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 帝晨出北安門迎，皇太后及皇后御平臺候殯。

translations.literal: At dawn the Emperor went out the North Peace Gate to welcome it; the grand empress dowager and empress presided on the level platform to await the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the emperor went out the North Peace Gate to welcome the coffin; the grand empress dowager and empress waited on the level platform.

sentences.zh: 復入至清寧宮，親奉梓宮朝祖。

translations.literal: He re-entered to the Palace of Pure Tranquility and personally bore the coffin to pay court to the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: He re-entered the Palace of Pure Tranquility and personally bore the coffin to pay court to the ancestors.

sentences.zh: 百官步送德勝門外，惟送喪官騎送。

translations.literal: Officials escorted on foot as far as outside Desheng Gate; only the funeral escort officials rode in escort.
translations.idiomatic: Officials escorted the coffin on foot as far as outside Desheng Gate; only the funeral escort officials rode along.

sentences.zh: 明日，帝奉神主還京，百官迎於德勝門。

translations.literal: The next day the Emperor bore the spirit tablet back to the capital; officials welcomed it at Desheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the emperor bore the spirit tablet back to the capital, and officials welcomed it at Desheng Gate.

sentences.zh: 帝素服、腰絰御西角門，百官奉慰。

translations.literal: The Emperor in plain dress and waist mourning band presided at the West Corner Gate; officials performed consolation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, in plain dress with a waist mourning band, presided at the West Corner Gate, and officials performed the consolation rite.

sentences.zh: 卒哭，始釋服。

translations.literal: At the end of wailing, mourning dress was first laid aside.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of wailing, mourning dress was first laid aside.

sentences.zh: 孝宗母紀氏，憲宗妃也。

translations.literal: Lady Ji, mother of Xiaozong, was a consort of Xianzong.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Ji, mother of Emperor Xiaozong, was a consort of Emperor Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 成化中薨，輟朝如故事。

translations.literal: She died in the Chenghua reign; court was suspended as in precedent.
translations.idiomatic: She died during the Chenghua reign, and court was suspended as in precedent.

sentences.zh: 自初喪及葬，帝及皇太后、中宮、妃、主、皇子皆致祭。

translations.literal: From the first mourning through burial, the Emperor, grand empress dowager, central palace, consorts, princesses, and imperial sons all offered sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: From the first mourning through burial, the emperor, the grand empress dowager, the empress, consorts, princesses, and imperial sons all offered sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 遣皇子奉祝冊行禮，塋域、葬儀俱從厚。

translations.literal: An imperial son was dispatched to bear the prayer register and perform the rite; the burial ground and funeral ceremony were both carried out with full generosity.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial son was dispatched to bear the prayer register and perform the rite; both the burial ground and the funeral ceremony were carried out with full generosity.

sentences.zh: 皇親百官及命婦送葬設祭，皆如儀。

translations.literal: Imperial kin, officials, and titled wives who escorted the burial and set up sacrifices all followed protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial kin, officials, and titled wives who escorted the burial and set up sacrifices all followed protocol.

sentences.zh: 世宗祖母邵氏，嘉靖元年崩。

translations.literal: Lady Shao, grandmother of Shizong, died in the first year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Shao, grandmother of Emperor Shizong, died in the first year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 服除，部臣毛澄等請即吉視事。

translations.literal: When mourning was completed, ministry officials Mao Cheng and others requested that auspicious dress be assumed immediately to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the mourning period ended, ministry officials Mao Cheng and others asked that the emperor assume auspicious dress and resume affairs at once.

sentences.zh: 議再上，命考孝肅太皇太后喪禮。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted again; he was ordered to examine the mourning rites for the late Grand Empress Dowager Xiaosu.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted again, and the emperor was ordered to examine the mourning rites for the late Grand Empress Dowager Xiaosu.

sentences.zh: 澄等言：「孝肅崩時，距葬期不遠，故暫持凶服，以待山陵事竣，與今不同。

translations.literal: Cheng and others said: "When Xiaosu died, the burial date was not far off, so mourning dress was temporarily retained to await completion of the mausoleum works; this differs from the present case."
translations.idiomatic: Cheng and others said: "When Grand Empress Dowager Xiaosu died, the burial was not far off, so mourning dress was temporarily retained until the mausoleum work was finished; that case differs from the present one."

sentences.zh: 況當正旦朝元，亦不宜縞衣臨見萬國。

translations.literal: Moreover, at the New Year's Day audience it is also unsuitable to receive the myriad states in white hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at the New Year's Day audience it would also be unsuitable to receive the myriad states while dressed in white hemp mourning.

sentences.zh: 若孝思未忘，第毋御中門及不鳴鐘鼓足矣。

translations.literal: If filial remembrance is not forgotten, it is enough merely not to use the central gate and not to sound bells and drums.
translations.idiomatic: If filial remembrance is still keen, it is enough merely to refrain from using the central gate and from sounding bells and drums.

sentences.zh: 」從之，仍免朔望日升殿。

translations.literal: " This was followed; audiences on the first and fifteenth were still exempted.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved, and audiences on the first and fifteenth of the month were still exempted.

sentences.zh: 既葬四日，帝御奉天門，百官行奉慰禮，始從吉。

translations.literal: Four days after burial, the Emperor presided at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; officials performed the consolation rite; auspicious dress was first adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Four days after the burial, the emperor presided at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; officials performed the consolation rite; and auspicious dress was first adopted.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，孝宗皇后張氏崩，禮臣以舊制上。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing reign, Empress Zhang, consort of Xiaozong, died; ritual officials submitted the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign, Empress Zhang, consort of Emperor Xiaozong, died; ritual officials submitted the old regulations.

sentences.zh: 帝謂郊社不宜瀆，罷祭告。

translations.literal: The Emperor said the suburban altars and altars of soil and grain should not be profaned, and sacrificial announcements were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said the suburban altars and altars of soil and grain should not be profaned, and sacrificial announcements were abolished.

sentences.zh: 又謂躬行諸禮，前已諭代，亦罷謁廟禮。

translations.literal: He also said that personally performing the various rites had already been ordered to be delegated, and the rite of visiting the temple was also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He also said that personally performing the various rites had already been ordered delegated to others, and the rite of visiting the temple was abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 及太常寺以朝祖祔廟，請各廟捧主官，詔主俱不必出，蓋從殺也。

translations.literal: When the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, for paying court to the ancestors and collateral installation in the temple, requested tablet-bearing officials for each temple, an edict said the tablets need not all be brought out; this was a reduction in the rites.
translations.idiomatic: When the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, for paying court to the ancestors and collateral installation in the temple, requested tablet-bearing officials for each temple, an edict said the tablets need not all be brought out; this was a reduction in the rites.

sentences.zh: 先是，武宗皇后夏氏崩，禮部上儀注，有素冠、素服、絰帶舉哀及羣臣奉慰禮。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Empress Xia, consort of Wuzong, died, the Ministry of Rites submitted protocol notes including plain caps, plain dress, mourning bands, raising lamentation, and the assembled ministers' consolation rite.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Empress Xia, consort of Emperor Wuzong, died, the Ministry of Rites submitted protocol notes including plain caps, plain dress, mourning bands, raising lamentation, and the assembled ministers' consolation rite.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕於皇兄後無服，矧上奉兩宮，又迫聖母壽旦，忍用純素。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "I owe no mourning to my elder imperial brother's consort; moreover I attend upon the two palaces, and my holy mother's birthday is pressing—how can I bear to use pure white?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "I owe no mourning to my elder imperial brother's consort; moreover I attend upon the two palaces, and my holy mother's birthday is at hand—how can I bear to wear pure white mourning?"

sentences.zh: 朕青服視事，諸儀再擬。

translations.literal: I shall handle affairs in blue dress; let all the rites be drafted anew."
translations.idiomatic: I shall handle affairs in blue dress; let all the rites be drafted anew."

sentences.zh: 」於是尚書夏言等言：「莊肅皇后喪禮，在臣民無容議。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Minister Xia Yan and others said: "The mourning rites for Empress Zhuangsu allow no discussion among subjects."
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Minister Xia Yan and others said: "The mourning rites for Empress Zhuangsu are not open to discussion among subjects."

sentences.zh: 惟是皇上以天子之尊，服制既絕，不必御西角門。

translations.literal: Only, Your Majesty, as holder of the Son of Heaven's dignity, has mourning relations already severed and need not preside at the West Corner Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Only, Your Majesty, as Son of Heaven, has mourning relations already severed and need not preside at the West Corner Gate.

sentences.zh: 羣臣成服後，不當素服朝參。

translations.literal: After the assembled ministers have assumed full mourning, they should not attend court audience in plain dress.
translations.idiomatic: After the assembled ministers have assumed full mourning, they should not attend court audience in plain dress.

sentences.zh: 」及上喪葬儀，帝復諭：「毅皇后事宜與累朝元后不同，無几筵之奉，當即行祔廟，令皇后攝事於內殿。

translations.literal: " When the funeral protocol was submitted, the Emperor again instructed: "The affairs of Empress Yi differ from those of successive primary empresses; there is no spirit-table service; collateral installation in the temple should be carried out at once, and the empress should administer affairs in the inner hall."
translations.idiomatic: When the funeral protocol was submitted, the emperor again instructed: "The affairs of Empress Yi differ from those of successive primary empresses; there is no spirit-table service; collateral installation in the temple should be carried out at once, and the empress should administer affairs in the inner hall."

sentences.zh: 」言等議：「按禮，卒哭乃行祔裏告。

translations.literal: " Yan and others deliberated: "According to the rites, only at the end of wailing is the collateral-installation garment announcement performed."
translations.idiomatic: Yan and others deliberated: "According to the rites, the collateral-installation garment announcement is performed only at the end of wailing."

sentences.zh: 蓋以新主當入，舊主當祧，故預以告也。

translations.literal: This is because the new tablet is about to enter and the old tablet is to be removed, so advance announcement is made.
translations.idiomatic: This is because the new tablet is about to enter and the old tablet is to be removed, so advance announcement is made.

sentences.zh: 此在常典則然，非今日議例。

translations.literal: In the regular canon this is so; it is not the case under discussion today.
translations.idiomatic: That holds in the regular canon, but it is not the case under discussion today.

sentences.zh: 毅皇后神主誠宜即祔太廟，以妥神靈，而祔告之禮宜免。

translations.literal: Empress Yi's spirit tablet truly should be installed at once in the Grand Temple to settle the spirit, but the collateral-installation announcement rite should be waived.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Yi's spirit tablet truly should be installed at once in the Grand Temple to settle her spirit, but the collateral-installation announcement rite should be waived.

sentences.zh: 」因具上其儀。

translations.literal: " They thereupon submitted the full protocol.
translations.idiomatic: They thereupon submitted the full protocol.

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The decree approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The decree approved it.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年，世宗皇后陳氏崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing, Empress Chen, consort of Shizong, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of the Jiajing reign, Empress Chen, consort of Emperor Shizong, died.

sentences.zh: 禮部上喪祭儀，帝疑過隆。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites submitted the mourning and sacrifice protocol; the Emperor suspected it was excessively grand.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites submitted the mourning and sacrifice protocol; the emperor suspected it was excessively grand.

sentences.zh: 議再上，帝自裁定，概從減殺，欲九日釋服。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted again; the Emperor ruled himself, generally following reduction, wishing to lay aside mourning in nine days.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted again; the emperor ruled himself, generally following reductions in the rites, and wished to lay aside mourning in nine days.

sentences.zh: 閣臣張璁等言：「夫婦之倫，參三綱而立。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Zhang Cong and others said: "The bond of husband and wife stands among the Three Bonds."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Zhang Cong and others said: "The bond of husband and wife stands among the Three Bonds."

sentences.zh: 人君乃綱常之主，尤不可不慎。

translations.literal: The ruler is master of these constants and must be especially careful.
translations.idiomatic: The ruler is master of these constants and must be especially careful.

sentences.zh: 《左傳》昭公十五年六月乙丑，周景王太子壽卒。

translations.literal: The Zuo Commentary, Duke Zhao year 15, sixth month, yichou day: King Jing of Zhou's heir Shou died.
translations.idiomatic: The Zuo Commentary records that in the fifteenth year of Duke Zhao, on the yichou day of the sixth month, King Jing of Zhou's heir Shou died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊寅，王穆後崩。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, wuyin day: Queen Mu died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the wuyin day of the eighth month, Queen Mu died.

sentences.zh: 叔向曰：『王一歲而有三年之喪二焉。

translations.literal: Shuxiang said: "In one year the king has two three-year mournings."
translations.idiomatic: Shuxiang said: "In one year the king has two three-year mourning periods."

sentences.zh: 』蓋古禮，父爲子，夫爲妻，皆服報服三年。

translations.literal: " For in ancient rites, a father for a son and a husband for a wife both wore responsive mourning for three years.
translations.idiomatic: For in ancient rites, a father mourning a son and a husband mourning a wife both wore responsive mourning for three years.

sentences.zh: 後世，夫爲妻，始製爲齊衰杖期，父母在則不杖。

translations.literal: In later ages, a husband for a wife was first regulated as hemmed hemp with staff for one year; if parents were living, no staff was used.
translations.idiomatic: In later ages, a husband mourning a wife was first regulated as hemmed hemp with staff for one year; if his parents were still living, no staff was used.

sentences.zh: 《喪服》，自期以下，諸侯絕，然特爲旁期言。

translations.literal: Mourning Dress: from one-year mourning downward, feudal lords are exempt, yet this speaks specifically of collateral one-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In Mourning Dress, from one-year mourning downward feudal lords are exempt, yet that speaks specifically of collateral one-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 若妻喪，本自三年報服，殺爲期年，則固未嘗絕者。

translations.literal: As for a wife's mourning, it originally was three-year responsive mourning, reduced to one year—thus it was never abolished.
translations.idiomatic: As for mourning a wife, it was originally three-year responsive mourning, reduced to one year—thus it was never abolished altogether.

sentences.zh: 今皇上爲後服期，以日易月，僅十二日。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty mourns the empress for one year, counting days as months, for only twelve days.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty mourns the empress for one year, counting days as months, for only twelve days.

sentences.zh: 臣子爲君母服三年，以日易月，僅二十七日。

translations.literal: Subjects mourn the ruler's mother for three years, counting days as months, for only twenty-seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Subjects mourn the ruler's mother for three years, counting days as months, for only twenty-seven days.

sentences.zh: 較諸古禮，已至殺矣。

translations.literal: Compared with ancient rites, this is already reduced to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with ancient rites, this is already reduced to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 皇上宜服期，十二日，臣子素服，終二十七日。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should wear one-year mourning for twelve days; subjects in plain dress for twenty-seven days in all.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should wear one-year mourning for twelve days; subjects should wear plain dress for the full twenty-seven days.

sentences.zh: 不然，則恩紀不明，典禮有乖。

translations.literal: Otherwise affection and rank are unclear and canonical rites are violated.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise affection and rank will be unclear and canonical rites will be violated.

sentences.zh: 」禮臣方獻夫亦雜引《儀禮·喪服》等篇，反覆爭辨，並《三朝聖諭》所載仁孝皇后崩，太宗衰服後，仍服數月白衣冠故事以證之。

translations.literal: " The ritual official Fang Xianfu also cited in mixed fashion chapters such as Ceremonial Rites, Mourning Dress, arguing back and forth, and also the precedent recorded in Imperial Instructions of Three Reigns that when Empress Renxiao died, after Taizong's hemp mourning he still wore white garments and caps for several months, to prove the point.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual official Fang Xianfu also cited chapters such as Ceremonial Rites and Mourning Dress, arguing back and forth, and cited the precedent recorded in Imperial Instructions of Three Reigns that after Empress Renxiao died, the Taizu emperor, after his hemp mourning, still wore white garments and caps for several months.

sentences.zh: 帝言：「文皇后喪時，上無聖母，下有東宮，從重盡禮爲宜。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "When Empress Wen died, above there was no holy mother and below there was the Eastern Palace; following the weightier rites to the full was fitting."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "When Empress Wen died, there was no holy mother above and there was the Eastern Palace below; following the weightier rites to the full was fitting."

sentences.zh: 今不敢不更其制。

translations.literal: Now I dare not fail to change that system."
translations.idiomatic: Now I dare not fail to change that system."

sentences.zh: 」已，詹事霍韜言：「今百官遭妻喪，無服衰蒞事之禮。

translations.literal: " Thereafter Supervisor of the Heir Apparent Huo Tao said: "Today when officials suffer a wife's death, there is no rite of wearing hemp to handle affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the Supervisor of the Heir Apparent Huo Tao said: "Today when officials suffer a wife's death, there is no rite of wearing hemp mourning while conducting affairs."

sentences.zh: 蓋妻喪內而不外，陰不可當陽也。

translations.literal: For a wife's mourning is inner and not outer; yin cannot confront yang.
translations.idiomatic: For a wife's mourning is private and not public; yin cannot confront yang.

sentences.zh: 聖諭云：『素服十日，仿輟朝之義。

translations.literal: The holy instruction says: "Plain dress for ten days, following the meaning of suspending court."
translations.idiomatic: The holy instruction says: "Plain dress for ten days, following the meaning of suspending court."

sentences.zh: 』於內廷行之則可。

translations.literal: " In the inner court this may be done.
translations.idiomatic: In the inner court this may be done.

sentences.zh: 若對臨百官，總理萬幾，履當陽之位，行中宮之服則不可。

translations.literal: But to face the assembled officials, oversee the myriad affairs, tread the position of true yang, and wear the central palace's dress is impossible.
translations.idiomatic: But to face the assembled officials, oversee the myriad affairs, occupy the position of true yang, and wear the central palace's mourning dress is impossible.

sentences.zh: 百官爲皇后服衰，爲其母儀天下也。

translations.literal: Officials wear hemp for the empress because she is mother and model to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Officials wear hemp mourning for the empress because she is mother and model to all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 禮，父在爲母，杖不上於堂，尊父也。

translations.literal: In the rites, when the father is living one mourns the mother, the staff is not brought into the hall—this honors the father.
translations.idiomatic: In the rites, when the father is still living one mourns the mother, the mourning staff is not brought into the hall—this honors the father.

sentences.zh: 於朝廷何獨不然？

translations.literal: Why should it alone be otherwise at court?
translations.idiomatic: Why should it alone be otherwise at court?

sentences.zh: 臣請陛下玄冠素服，御西角門十日，即玄冠玄服御奉天門，百官入左掖門則烏紗帽、青衣侍班。

translations.literal: Your servant requests that Your Majesty wear dark cap and plain dress and preside at the West Corner Gate for ten days, then dark cap and dark dress at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; when officials enter the Left Flank Gate they wear black gauze caps and blue garments on attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant requests that Your Majesty wear a dark cap and plain dress and preside at the West Corner Gate for ten days, then a dark cap and dark dress at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; when officials enter the Left Flank Gate they should wear black gauze caps and blue garments while attending.

sentences.zh: 退出公署及私室，則仍素服白帽二十七日。

translations.literal: On leaving government offices and private chambers, they still wear plain dress and white caps for twenty-seven days.
translations.idiomatic: On leaving their government offices and private chambers, they should still wear plain dress and white caps for twenty-seven days.

sentences.zh: 若曰於禮猶有未慊，則山陵事畢而除。

translations.literal: If it is said that in the rites there is still dissatisfaction, then lay mourning aside when the mausoleum work is finished."
translations.idiomatic: If it is said that the rites are still not fully satisfied, then lay mourning aside when the mausoleum work is finished."

sentences.zh: 」帝從其言。

translations.literal: " The Emperor followed his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 尋定進冊諡儀，禮部議：「先期，帝袞冕告奉先殿、崇先殿。

translations.literal: Soon the protocol for advancing the posthumous register and name was fixed; the Ministry of Rites deliberated: "In advance, the Emperor in dragon robes and cap announces to the Hall of Forefathers and Hall of Honored Forefathers."
translations.idiomatic: Soon the protocol for advancing the posthumous register and name was fixed; the Ministry of Rites deliberated: "In advance, the emperor in dragon robes and cap announces to the Hall of Forefathers and the Hall of Honored Forefathers."

sentences.zh: 至期，帝常服御奉天門，正副使常服，百官淺淡色衣、黑角帶，入班行禮如儀。

translations.literal: On the appointed day, the Emperor in regular dress presides at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; primary and secondary envoys in regular dress; officials in pale-colored garments and black horn belts enter ranks and perform the rite as in protocol.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day, the emperor in regular dress presides at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; the primary and secondary envoys in regular dress; officials in pale-colored garments and black horn belts enter ranks and perform the rite as in protocol.

sentences.zh: 節冊至右順門，內侍捧入正門，至几筵前置於案。

translations.literal: The staff and register reach the Right Shun Gate; inner attendants bear them in through the main gate to before the spirit table and place them on the table.
translations.idiomatic: The staff and register reach the Right Shun Gate; inner attendants bear them in through the main gate to before the spirit table and place them on the table.

sentences.zh: 內贊贊就位上香，宣冊官立宣訖，復置冊於案。

translations.literal: The inner usher praises taking position and presenting incense; the register-proclaiming official stands, proclaims, finishes, and replaces the register on the table.
translations.idiomatic: The inner usher prompts taking position and presenting incense; the register-proclaiming official stands, proclaims, finishes, and replaces the register on the table.

sentences.zh: 內侍持節由正門出，以節授正副使，報禮畢，正副使持節覆命。

translations.literal: Inner attendants bear the staff out through the main gate, hand the staff to the primary and secondary envoys, report the rite complete, and the envoys bear the staff back to report.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants bear the staff out through the main gate, hand it to the primary and secondary envoys, report that the rite is complete, and the envoys bear the staff back to report to the throne.

sentences.zh: 」次日，禮部謄黃頒示天下。

translations.literal: " The next day the Ministry of Rites copied the yellow edict and promulgated it throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the Ministry of Rites copied the yellow edict and promulgated it throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 時中宮喪禮自文皇后而後，至是始再行。

translations.literal: At this time the central palace mourning rites, since Empress Wen, were performed again only now.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the central palace mourning rites, since Empress Wen, were performed again only now.

sentences.zh: 永樂時典禮毀於火，《會典》所載皆略，乃斷自帝心，著爲令。

translations.literal: In the Yongle reign the canonical ritual texts were destroyed by fire; what the Collected Statutes records is all abbreviated; these were decided by the Emperor's mind and enacted as regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongle reign the canonical ritual texts were destroyed by fire; what the Collected Statutes records is all abbreviated; these rites were decided by the emperor himself and enacted as regulations.

sentences.zh: 梓宮將葬，帝新定諸儀，亦從減損。

translations.literal: When the coffin was about to be buried, the Emperor newly fixed the various rites, also following reduction.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin was about to be buried, the emperor newly fixed the various rites, again following reductions.

sentences.zh: 以思善門逼近仁智殿，命百宮哭臨止一日，亦罷辭祖禮，喪由左王門出。

translations.literal: Because the Gate of Cherishing Goodness was close to the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom, he ordered officials' wailing and attendance for only one day, also abolished the farewell-to-ancestors rite, and the mourning procession went out by the Left King's Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Gate of Cherishing Goodness was close to the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom, he ordered officials' wailing and attendance for only one day, abolished the farewell-to-ancestors rite, and had the mourning procession go out by the Left King's Gate.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，皇后方氏崩，即日發喪，諭禮部：「皇后嘗救朕危，其考元后喪禮行之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Empress Fang died; mourning was proclaimed that same day; he instructed the Ministry of Rites: "The empress once saved me from peril; examine and carry out the primary empress mourning rites."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, Empress Fang died; mourning was proclaimed that same day; he instructed the Ministry of Rites: "The empress once saved me from peril; examine and carry out the primary empress mourning rites."

sentences.zh: 」禮部定儀：「以第四日成服，自後黑冠素服，十日後易淺色衣，俱西角門視朝。

translations.literal: " The Ministry of Rites fixed the protocol: "On the fourth day assume full mourning; thereafter black cap and plain dress; after ten days change to pale-colored garments; all hold court at the West Corner Gate."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites fixed the protocol: "On the fourth day assume full mourning; thereafter black cap and plain dress; after ten days change to pale-colored garments; all hold court at the West Corner Gate."

sentences.zh: 百官十日素服絰帶，自後烏紗帽、黑角帶、素服，通前二十七日。

translations.literal: Officials wear plain dress and mourning bands for ten days; thereafter black gauze caps, black horn belts, and plain dress, twenty-seven days in all.
translations.idiomatic: Officials wear plain dress and mourning bands for ten days; thereafter black gauze caps, black horn belts, and plain dress, for twenty-seven days in all.

sentences.zh: 帝常服於奉天門視朝，百官淺色衣，鳴鐘鼓、鳴鞭如常，朔望不升殿。

translations.literal: The Emperor in regular dress holds court at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; officials in pale garments; bells, drums, and whip sounded as usual; on the first and fifteenth he does not ascend the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in regular dress holds court at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; officials in pale garments; bells, drums, and whip are sounded as usual; on the first and fifteenth he does not ascend the hall.

sentences.zh: 梓宮發引，百官始常服。

translations.literal: When the coffin was escorted forth, officials first wore regular dress.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin was escorted forth, officials first wore regular dress.

sentences.zh: 帝於奉先等殿行禮，俱常服。

translations.literal: The Emperor performing rites at the Hall of Forefathers and the like all wore regular dress.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor performed rites at the Hall of Forefathers and the like, he wore regular dress throughout.

sentences.zh: 於几筵祭則服其服。

translations.literal: For spirit-table sacrifices he wore the appropriate mourning.
translations.idiomatic: For spirit-table sacrifices he wore the appropriate mourning garments.

sentences.zh: 服滿日，命中官代祭。

translations.literal: On the day mourning was completed, he ordered inner eunuchs to sacrifice in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On the day mourning was completed, he ordered inner eunuchs to sacrifice in his place.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 尋諭：「皇妃列太子後非禮，其改正。

translations.literal: Soon he instructed: "Listing an imperial consort after the crown prince is not ritual; correct this."
translations.idiomatic: Soon he instructed: "Listing an imperial consort after the crown prince is not proper ritual; correct this."

sentences.zh: 」及葬，部臣以舊儀請。

translations.literal: " At burial, ministry officials requested according to the old protocol.
translations.idiomatic: At the burial, ministry officials requested according to the old protocol.

sentences.zh: 詔梓宮由中道行，虞祭如制用九數。

translations.literal: An edict said the coffin should proceed by the central avenue; yu sacrifices as regulated used the number nine.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said the coffin should proceed by the central avenue; yu sacrifices as regulated used the number nine.

sentences.zh: 安玄宮居左，他日即配祀。

translations.literal: The Dark Palace installation was placed on the left; on another day it would receive collateral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The Dark Palace installation was placed on the left; on another day it would receive collateral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 部臣覆上儀注，改席殿曰行享殿。

translations.literal: Ministry officials resubmitted the protocol notes, changing Seat Hall to Processional Offering Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry officials resubmitted the protocol notes, changing Seat Hall to Processional Offering Hall.

sentences.zh: 又以孝潔皇后自發引至神主還京將半載，遇令節百官常服，今孝烈皇后初十日發引，十五日即還，事禮不同，以諸臣服制請。

translations.literal: Also, from Empress Xiaojie's coffin escort to the spirit tablet's return to the capital was nearly half a year; on festival days officials wore regular dress; now Empress Xiaolie's coffin is escorted on the tenth day and returns on the fifteenth—the affairs and rites differ; they requested mourning dress for all.
translations.idiomatic: Also, from Empress Xiaojie's coffin escort to the spirit tablet's return to the capital took nearly half a year, and on festival days officials wore regular dress; now Empress Xiaolie's coffin is escorted on the tenth day and returns on the fifteenth—the circumstances and rites differ; they requested mourning dress for all.

sentences.zh: 帝命隨喪往來者，仍制服。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered those who went back and forth with the mourning to continue wearing mourning dress.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered those who went back and forth with the mourning procession to continue wearing mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 祭畢，烏紗帽素服入朝，素冠素服辦事。

translations.literal: After sacrifice, enter court in black gauze cap and plain dress; handle affairs in plain cap and plain dress.
translations.idiomatic: After sacrifice, enter court in black gauze cap and plain dress; handle affairs in plain cap and plain dress.

sentences.zh: 迎主仍制服，思善門外行安神禮，更素冠素服從事。

translations.literal: Welcoming the tablet still in mourning dress; outside the Gate of Cherishing Goodness perform the spirit-settling rite; change again to plain cap and plain dress for the work.
translations.idiomatic: When welcoming the tablet, still wear mourning dress; outside the Gate of Cherishing Goodness perform the spirit-settling rite; then change again to plain cap and plain dress for the work.

sentences.zh: 先是，帝命孝烈居左，而遷孝潔。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Emperor had ordered Xiaolie to be placed on the left and Xiaojie moved.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the emperor had ordered Xiaolie to be placed on the left and Xiaojie to be moved.

sentences.zh: 既而以孝潔久安，不宜妄動，罷不行。

translations.literal: Then, because Xiaojie had long been settled, it was unsuitable to move her rashly; this was abandoned and not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Then, because Xiaojie had long been settled, it was unsuitable to move her rashly; the plan was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 乃更命孝烈居右，而虛其左以自待。

translations.literal: He then ordered Xiaolie placed on the right and left the left vacant to await himself.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered Xiaolie placed on the right and left the left side vacant to await himself.

sentences.zh: 穆宗母杜氏，三十三年薨。

translations.literal: Lady Du, mother of Muzong, died in the thirty-third year.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Du, mother of Emperor Muzong, died in the thirty-third year of his reign.

sentences.zh: 禮部言：「宜用成化中淑妃紀氏喪制。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites said: "The mourning system for Virtuous Consort Ji in the Chenghua reign should be used."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites said: "The mourning system used for Virtuous Consort Ji in the Chenghua reign should be applied."

sentences.zh: 且裕王已成婚，宜持服主喪，送葬出城。

translations.literal: Moreover the Prince of Yu is already married and should wear mourning and preside over the mourning, escorting the burial outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Prince of Yu is already married and should wear mourning, preside over the funeral, and escort the burial outside the city.

sentences.zh: 」乃議輟朝五日，裕王遵《孝慈錄》斬衰三年。

translations.literal: " Thereupon it was deliberated to suspend court for five days; the Prince of Yu was to follow the Record of Filial Kindness in cut-edge hemp mourning for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon court was suspended for five days, and the Prince of Yu was to follow the Record of Filial Kindness in wearing cut-edge hemp mourning for three years.

sentences.zh: 欽遣大臣題主，開塋掩壙，祠謝后土，並用工部官，送葬儀仗人數皆增於舊。

translations.literal: By imperial order senior ministers were dispatched to inscribe the spirit tablet, open the tomb mound, and seal the burial chamber; sacrifices of thanks were offered to Queen Mother Earth, all using officials of the Ministry of Works; and the numbers for the funeral escort and honor guard were all increased beyond former practice.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order senior ministers were dispatched to inscribe the spirit tablet, open the tomb mound, and seal the burial chamber; sacrifices of thanks were offered to Queen Mother Earth, with Ministry of Works officials handling the work; and the numbers for the funeral escort and honor guard were all increased beyond former practice.

sentences.zh: 帝謂非禮之正，令酌考賢妃鄭氏例。

translations.literal: The Emperor said this was not proper ritual and ordered deliberation with reference to the precedent of Virtuous Consort Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said this was not proper ritual and ordered that the precedent of Virtuous Consort Zheng be consulted.

sentences.zh: 於是尚書歐陽德等覆上儀注，輟朝二日，不鳴鐘鼓。

translations.literal: Thereupon Minister Ouyang De and others resubmitted the protocol: court was to be suspended for two days and bells and drums were not to be sounded.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Minister Ouyang De and others resubmitted the protocol: court was to be suspended for two days, and bells and drums were not to be sounded.

sentences.zh: 帝服淺淡色衣，奉天門視事，百官淺色衣、烏紗帽、黑角帶朝參。

translations.literal: The Emperor wore light-colored garments and conducted affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Favor; all officials wore light-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore light-colored garments and conducted affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Favor; all officials wore light-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts when attending court.

sentences.zh: 命裕王主饋奠之事，王率妃入宮，素服哭盡哀，四拜視殮。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yu was ordered to preside over the offering rites; the prince led his consort into the palace, wept in plain dress to the full measure of grief, and performed four bows at the viewing of the encoffining.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yu was ordered to preside over the offering rites; the prince led his consort into the palace, wept in plain dress to the full measure of grief, and performed four bows at the viewing of the encoffining.

sentences.zh: 成服後，朝夕哭臨三日。

translations.literal: After assuming full mourning, morning and evening weeping attendance continued for three days.
translations.idiomatic: After assuming full mourning, he attended morning and evening weeping rites for three days.

sentences.zh: 後每日一奠，通前二十七日而止。

translations.literal: Afterward one offering was made each day, totaling twenty-seven days in all, then it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward one offering was made each day for a total of twenty-seven days, then the rites ceased.

sentences.zh: 仍於燕居盡斬衰三年之制。

translations.literal: In private quarters he still observed the full rule of cut-edge hemp mourning for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In private quarters he still observed the full rule of cut-edge hemp mourning for three years.

sentences.zh: 冊諡焚黃日，陳祭儀，裕王詣靈前行禮。

translations.literal: On the day of enshrining the posthumous title and performing the yellow-edict burning ritual, the sacrificial protocol was displayed and the Prince of Yu went before the catafalque to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of enshrining the posthumous title and performing the yellow-edict burning ritual, the sacrificial protocol was displayed and the Prince of Yu went before the catafalque to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 喪出玄武門，裕王步送至京城門外，路祭畢，還宮。

translations.literal: When the funeral procession left by the Xuanwu Gate, the Prince of Yu walked in escort to outside the capital gate; when the roadside sacrifice was complete, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the funeral procession left by the Xuanwu Gate, the Prince of Yu walked in escort as far as outside the capital gate; when the roadside sacrifice was complete, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 帝謂焚黃乃制命，非王可行，仍如常儀。

translations.literal: The Emperor said the yellow-edict burning was an imperial command and not something a prince might perform; the usual ritual was still to be followed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said the yellow-edict burning was an imperial command and not something a prince might perform; the usual ritual was still to be followed.

sentences.zh: 禮部覆奏： 「皇妃焚黃儀，傳訛已久。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites replied in memorial: "The yellow-edict burning ritual for an imperial consort has long been transmitted in error.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites replied in memorial: "The yellow-edict burning ritual for an imperial consort has long been transmitted in error.

sentences.zh: 皆拜獻酒，跪讀祝，乃參用上尊諡之儀，而未思賜諡爲制命，其祭文稱皇帝遣諭，與上尊諡不同。

translations.literal: All bowed and offered wine and knelt to read the prayer, thereby adopting the ritual for a supreme posthumous title, yet without considering that a bestowed title is an imperial command; the sacrificial text says the emperor dispatched an instruction, which differs from a supreme posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: All bowed and offered wine and knelt to read the prayer, thereby adopting the ritual for a supreme posthumous title, yet without considering that a bestowed title is an imperial command; the sacrificial text says the emperor dispatched an instruction, which differs from a supreme posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 今奉旨以常禮從事，當改議賜諡，如賜祭禮。

translations.literal: Now, following the imperial order to proceed by ordinary ritual, deliberation on the bestowed title should be revised, as with the ritual for a bestowed sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Now, following the imperial order to proceed by ordinary ritual, deliberation on the bestowed title should be revised, as with the ritual for a bestowed sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 讀祝、宣冊皆平立不拜。

translations.literal: Reading the prayer and proclaiming the charter were both performed standing upright without bowing.
translations.idiomatic: Reading the prayer and proclaiming the charter were both performed standing upright without bowing.

sentences.zh: 」報可，著爲令。

translations.literal: " It was approved and enacted as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved and enacted as a regulation.

sentences.zh: 穆宗皇后李氏，裕邸元妃也，先薨，葬西山。

translations.literal: Empress Li, consort of Emperor Muzong, had been the original consort of the Prince of Yu's residence; she died earlier and was buried on West Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Li, consort of Emperor Muzong, had been the original consort of the Prince of Yu's residence; she died earlier and was buried on West Mountain.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，加諡孝懿皇后，親告世宗几筵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing she was given the posthumous title Empress Xiaoyi, and the emperor personally announced it at the spirit table of Emperor Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longqing she was given the posthumous title Empress Xiaoyi, and the emperor personally announced it at the spirit table of Emperor Shizong.

sentences.zh: 御皇極門，遣大臣持節捧冊寶詣陵園上之。

translations.literal: At the Gate of Supreme Pole he dispatched senior ministers bearing credentials to carry the charter and seal to the mausoleum and elevate them there.
translations.idiomatic: At the Gate of Supreme Pole he dispatched senior ministers bearing credentials to carry the charter and seal to the mausoleum and elevate them there.

sentences.zh: 神宗母皇太后李氏，萬曆四十二年崩。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Li, mother of Emperor Shenzong, died in the forty-second year of Wanli.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Li, mother of Emperor Shenzong, died in the forty-second year of the Wanli reign.

sentences.zh: 帝諭禮部從優具儀，帝衰服行奠祭禮。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed the Ministry of Rites to prepare the full ritual with preferential treatment; the emperor in the highest grade of mourning performed the offering and sacrifice rites.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed the Ministry of Rites to prepare the full ritual with preferential treatment; the emperor in the highest grade of mourning performed the offering and sacrifice rites.

sentences.zh: 穆廟皇妃、中宮妃嬪、太子、諸王、公主以下皆成服。

translations.literal: Imperial consorts of the Muzong temple, inner-palace consorts and concubines, the crown prince, all princes, and princesses downward all assumed full mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial consorts of the Muzong temple, inner-palace consorts and concubines, the crown prince, all princes, and princesses downward all assumed full mourning.

sentences.zh: 百官詣慈寧宮門外哭臨。

translations.literal: All officials went to outside the Gate of Cining Palace for weeping attendance.
translations.idiomatic: All officials went to the area outside the Gate of Cining Palace for weeping attendance.

sentences.zh: 命婦入宮門哭臨。

translations.literal: Titled wives entered the palace gate for weeping attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Titled wives entered the palace gate for weeping attendance.

sentences.zh: 餘俱如大喪禮。

translations.literal: The rest all followed the ritual for a great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Everything else followed the ritual for a great mourning.

sentences.zh: ○興宗帝后陵寢

translations.literal: ○ Mausoleums of Emperor Xingzong and Consort
translations.idiomatic: ○ Mausoleums of Emperor Xingzong and Consort

sentences.zh: ○睿宗帝后陵寢

translations.literal: ○ Mausoleums of Emperor Ruizong and Consort
translations.idiomatic: ○ Mausoleums of Emperor Ruizong and Consort

sentences.zh: 睿宗帝后陵寢在安陸州。

translations.literal: The mausoleums of Emperor Ruizong and his consort were in Anlu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The mausoleums of Emperor Ruizong and his consort were in Anlu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 世宗入立，追諡曰睿宗獻皇帝。

translations.literal: When Shizong entered the throne, he was given the posthumous title Emperor Ruizong the Offering.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, his father was given the posthumous title Emperor Ruizong the Offering.

sentences.zh: 葺陵廟，薦號曰顯陵。

translations.literal: The tomb temple was repaired and the recommended name Xianling was given.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb temple was repaired and the name Xianling was recommended for the mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 既而希進之徒屢言獻皇帝梓宮宜改葬天壽山。

translations.literal: Afterward those who sought advancement repeatedly said the catalpa coffin of the Offering Emperor ought to be reburied at Tianshou Mountain.
