translations.idiomatic: Afterward those who sought advancement repeatedly said the imperial bier of the Offering Emperor ought to be reburied at Tianshou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 帝不聽。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not heed them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not heed them.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十七年，帝母蔣太后崩。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiajing the emperor's mother, Empress Dowager Jiang, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Jiajing the emperor's mother, Empress Dowager Jiang, died.

sentences.zh: 禮部言：「歲除日，大行皇太后服制二十七日已滿，適遇正旦，請用黑冠、淺淡服受朝。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites said: "On New Year's Eve the mourning period of twenty-seven days for the late great empress dowager will be complete, and it happens to coincide with New Year's Day; we request that he receive court in a black cap and light-colored garments."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites said: "On New Year's Eve the mourning period of twenty-seven days for the late great empress dowager will be complete, and it happens to coincide with New Year's Day; we request that he receive court in a black cap and light-colored garments."

sentences.zh: 」疏未下，帝諭大學士夏言：「元旦玄極殿拜天，仍具祭服，先期一日宜變服否？

translations.literal: " Before the memorial was issued, the Emperor instructed Grand Secretary Xia Yan: "On New Year's Day, when worshipping Heaven in the Hall of Mysterious Pole, he will still wear sacrificial dress; should he change dress one day beforehand?"
translations.idiomatic: Before the memorial was issued, the emperor instructed Grand Secretary Xia Yan: "On New Year's Day, when worshipping Heaven in the Hall of Mysterious Pole, he will still wear sacrificial dress; should he change dress one day beforehand?"

sentences.zh: 」禮部請「正旦拜天、受朝，及先一日俱青服，孟春時享，前三日齋，青服，臣下同之，餘仍孝貞皇太后喪禮例」。

translations.literal: " The Ministry of Rites requested that "for New Year's Day worship of Heaven and receiving court, and for the day before, all wear green garments; for the spring seasonal sacrifice, three days of fasting beforehand in green garments, with officials and commoners alike; the rest still follow the mourning precedent for Empress Dowager Xiaozhen."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites requested that for New Year's Day worship of Heaven and receiving court, and for the day before, all wear green garments; for the spring seasonal sacrifice, three days of fasting beforehand in green garments, with officials and commoners alike; the rest still follow the mourning precedent for Empress Dowager Xiaozhen.

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: This was not followed.
translations.idiomatic: This was not followed.

sentences.zh: 於是定議，歲除日變服玄色吉衣，元旦祭服玄極殿行告祀禮，具翼善冠、黃袍御殿，百官公服致詞，鳴鐘鼓、鳴鞭，奏堂上樂。

translations.literal: Thereupon a decision was fixed: on New Year's Eve he would change into dark-colored auspicious garments; on New Year's Day in sacrificial dress he would perform the announcement sacrifice in the Hall of Mysterious Pole; wearing the Yishan cap and yellow robe he would mount the throne hall; all officials in court dress would offer congratulations; bells and drums were sounded, the whip was cracked, and hall music was played.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon a decision was fixed: on New Year's Eve he would change into dark-colored auspicious garments; on New Year's Day in sacrificial dress he would perform the announcement sacrifice in the Hall of Mysterious Pole; wearing the Yishan cap and yellow robe he would mount the throne hall; all officials in court dress would offer congratulations; bells and drums were sounded, the whip was cracked, and hall music was played.

sentences.zh: 是時議南北遷祔，久不決。

translations.literal: At that time deliberation over relocating the collateral installation north or south went on long without resolution.
translations.idiomatic: At that time deliberation over relocating the collateral installation north or south went on long without resolution.

sentences.zh: 帝親詣承天。

translations.literal: The Emperor went in person to Chengtian.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went in person to Chengtian.

sentences.zh: 及歸，乃定議梓宮南祔。

translations.literal: Upon his return, the decision was fixed that the catalpa coffin would receive collateral installation in the south.
translations.idiomatic: Upon his return, the decision was fixed that the imperial bier would receive collateral installation in the south.

sentences.zh: 禮部上葬儀，自常典外，帝復增定太廟辭謁、承天門辭奠、朝陽門遣奠、題主後降神饗神，及梓宮登舟、升岸等祭。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites submitted the burial ritual; beyond the regular canon the Emperor further added provisions for farewell visits at the Grand Temple, farewell offerings at the Chengtian Gate, dispatch offerings at the Chaoyang Gate, spirit descent and spirit feasting after inscribing the tablet, and sacrifices when the catalpa coffin boarded the boat and ascended the shore.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites submitted the burial ritual; beyond the regular canon the emperor further added provisions for farewell visits at the Grand Temple, farewell offerings at the Chengtian Gate, dispatch offerings at the Chaoyang Gate, spirit descent and spirit feasting after inscribing the tablet, and sacrifices when the imperial bier boarded the boat and ascended the shore.

sentences.zh: 梓宮發引，帝衰服行諸禮如儀。

translations.literal: When the catalpa coffin departed, the Emperor in the highest grade of mourning performed all the rites according to protocol.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial bier departed, the emperor in the highest grade of mourning performed all the rites according to protocol.

sentences.zh: 百官步送朝陽門外，奠獻，使行遣奠禮。

translations.literal: All officials walked in escort to outside the Chaoyang Gate, presented the offering, and envoys performed the dispatch-offering ritual.
translations.idiomatic: All officials walked in escort to outside the Chaoyang Gate, presented the offering, and envoys performed the dispatch-offering ritual.

sentences.zh: 至通州，題主官覆命。

translations.literal: At Tongzhou the officer who had inscribed the tablet reported completion of his mission.
translations.idiomatic: At Tongzhou the officer who had inscribed the tablet reported completion of his mission.

sentences.zh: 神主回京，百官奉迎於門外，帝衰服率皇后以下哭迎午門內，奉安於几筵殿。

translations.literal: When the spirit tablet returned to the capital, all officials welcomed it outside the gate; the Emperor in the highest grade of mourning led the empress and those below in weeping welcome inside the Meridian Gate, and it was installed in the Spirit Table Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit tablet returned to the capital, all officials welcomed it outside the gate; the emperor in the highest grade of mourning led the empress and those below in weeping welcome inside the Meridian Gate, and it was installed in the Spirit Table Hall.

sentences.zh: 梓宮所過河瀆江山神祇，俱牲醴致祭。

translations.literal: At every river, hill, and earth spirit along the route of the catalpa coffin, livestock and libations were offered in sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: At every river, hill, and earth spirit along the route of the imperial bier, livestock and libations were offered in sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 勳臣青服行禮，梓宮升席殿。

translations.literal: Meritorious officials in green garments performed the rites as the catalpa coffin ascended the Rest Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious officials in green garments performed the rites as the imperial bier ascended the Rest Hall.

sentences.zh: 先詣睿宗舊陵，奉遷於祾恩殿，復奉梓宮至殿，合葬於新寢。

translations.literal: They first went to the old tomb of Emperor Ruizong and transferred it to the Hall of Ling'en Grace; then they again brought the catalpa coffin to the hall and buried them together in the new chamber.
translations.idiomatic: They first went to the old tomb of Emperor Ruizong and transferred it to the Hall of Ling'en Grace; then they again brought the imperial bier to the hall and buried them together in the new chamber.

sentences.zh: ○皇妃等喪葬

translations.literal: ○ Funeral Rites for Imperial Consorts and Others
translations.idiomatic: ○ Funeral Rites for Imperial Consorts and Others

sentences.zh: 洪武七年九月，貴妃孫氏薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the seventh year of Hongwu, Honored Consort Sun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the seventh year of Hongwu, Honored Consort Sun died.

sentences.zh: 無子，太祖命吳王橚主喪事，服慈母服，斬衰三年。

translations.literal: She had no son; Taizu ordered the Prince of Wu, Zhu, to preside over the funeral, wear mourning for a foster mother, and observe cut-edge hemp mourning for three years.
translations.idiomatic: She had no son; Taizu ordered the Prince of Wu, Zhu, to preside over the funeral, wear mourning for a foster mother, and observe cut-edge hemp mourning for three years.

sentences.zh: 東宮諸王皆服期。

translations.literal: The crown prince and all princes wore one-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince and all princes wore one-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 由是作《孝慈錄》。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Record of Filial Kindness was composed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Record of Filial Kindness was composed.

sentences.zh: 永樂中，貴妃王氏薨。

translations.literal: During the Yongle reign, Honored Consort Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongle reign, Honored Consort Wang died.

sentences.zh: 輟朝五日，御祭一罈，皇后、皇妃、皇太子各祭一罈，親王共祭一罈，公主共祭一罈。

translations.literal: Court was suspended for five days; the imperial sacrifice was one altar; the empress, imperial consort, and crown prince each sacrificed at one altar; imperial princes jointly sacrificed at one altar; princesses jointly sacrificed at one altar.
translations.idiomatic: Court was suspended for five days; the imperial sacrifice was one altar; the empress, imperial consort, and crown prince each sacrificed at one altar; imperial princes jointly sacrificed at one altar; and princesses jointly sacrificed at one altar.

sentences.zh: 七七、百日期、再期，皆祭贈諡冊，行焚黃禮。

translations.literal: At forty-nine days, the hundred-day anniversary, and the second anniversary, sacrifices were all offered with the bestowed posthumous charter, and the yellow-edict burning ritual was performed.
translations.idiomatic: At forty-nine days, the hundred-day anniversary, and the second anniversary, sacrifices were all offered with the bestowed posthumous charter, and the yellow-edict burning ritual was performed.

sentences.zh: 開塋域，遣官祠后土。

translations.literal: The tomb precinct was opened and officials were dispatched to sacrifice to Queen Mother Earth.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb precinct was opened and officials were dispatched to sacrifice to Queen Mother Earth.

sentences.zh: 發引前期，辭靈祭壇與初喪同，惟增六尚司及內官、內使各一罈。

translations.literal: Before the departure of the procession, the farewell-to-the-spirit sacrificial altar was the same as at the initial mourning, except that one altar each was added for the Six Bureaus and for inner officials and inner eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Before the departure of the procession, the farewell-to-the-spirit sacrificial altar was the same as at the initial mourning, except that one altar each was added for the Six Bureaus and for inner officials and inner eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 啓奠、祖奠、遣奠各遣祭一罈。

translations.literal: For the opening offering, ancestral offering, and dispatch offering, one altar of dispatched sacrifice was assigned to each.
translations.idiomatic: For the opening offering, ancestral offering, and dispatch offering, one altar of dispatched sacrifice was assigned to each.

sentences.zh: 發引日，百官送至路祭所，皇親駙馬共一罈，公侯伯文武共一罈，外命婦共一罈。

translations.literal: On the day the procession departed, all officials escorted it to the roadside sacrifice site; imperial kin and sons-in-law jointly one altar; dukes, marquises, earls, and civil and military officials jointly one altar; outer titled wives jointly one altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the day the procession departed, all officials escorted it to the roadside sacrifice site; imperial kin and sons-in-law jointly sacrificed at one altar; dukes, marquises, earls, and civil and military officials jointly at one altar; and outer titled wives jointly at one altar.

sentences.zh: 所過城門祭祀，內門遣內官，外門遣太常寺官。

translations.literal: At city gates passed along the route sacrifices were performed; for inner gates inner eunuchs were dispatched, for outer gates officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: At city gates along the route sacrifices were performed; for inner gates inner eunuchs were dispatched, for outer gates officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 下葬，遣奠、遣祭一罈。

translations.literal: At burial, the dispatch offering and dispatch sacrifice were one altar.
translations.idiomatic: At burial, the dispatch offering and dispatch sacrifice were performed at one altar.

sentences.zh: 掩壙，遣官祀后土，迎靈轎至享堂，行安神禮，遣祭一罈。

translations.literal: When the burial chamber was sealed, officials were dispatched to sacrifice to Queen Mother Earth; the spirit palanquin was welcomed to the Rest Hall and the pacification-of-the-spirit ritual was performed; the dispatch sacrifice was one altar.
translations.idiomatic: When the burial chamber was sealed, officials were dispatched to sacrifice to Queen Mother Earth; the spirit palanquin was welcomed to the Rest Hall and the pacification-of-the-spirit ritual was performed; the dispatch sacrifice was performed at one altar.

sentences.zh: 天順七年，敬妃劉氏薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianshun, Respected Consort Liu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tianshun, Respected Consort Liu died.

sentences.zh: 輟朝五日，帝服淺淡黃衣於奉天門視事，百官淺淡色衣、烏紗帽、黑角帶朝參。

translations.literal: Court was suspended for five days; the Emperor wore light yellow garments and conducted affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Favor; all officials wore light-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: Court was suspended for five days; the emperor wore light yellow garments and conducted affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Favor; all officials wore light-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts when attending court.

sentences.zh: 冊文置靈柩前，皇太子以下行三獻禮。

translations.literal: The charter text was placed before the bier; from the crown prince downward the three offerings were performed.
translations.idiomatic: The charter text was placed before the bier; from the crown prince downward the three offerings were performed.

sentences.zh: 靈柩前儀仗，內使女樂二十四人，花幡、雪柳女隊子二十人，女將軍十一人。

translations.literal: Before the bier in the honor guard were twenty-four female musicians from inner eunuchs, twenty female runners with flower banners and snow willows, and eleven female generals.
translations.idiomatic: Before the bier in the honor guard were twenty-four female musicians from inner eunuchs, twenty female runners with flower banners and snow willows, and eleven female generals.

sentences.zh: 自初喪至期年辭靈，各於常祭外增祭一罈。

translations.literal: From the initial mourning through the first-year farewell to the spirit, beyond the regular sacrifices one altar was added at each stage.
translations.idiomatic: From the initial mourning through the first-year farewell to the spirit, beyond the regular sacrifices one altar was added at each stage.

sentences.zh: 弘治十四年，憲廟麗妃章氏發引，輟朝一日。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongzhi, when Beautiful Consort Zhang of the Xian Temple departed in procession, court was suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Hongzhi, when Beautiful Consort Zhang of the Xian Temple departed in procession, court was suspended for one day.

sentences.zh: 凡陪葬諸妃，歲時俱享於殿內。

translations.literal: All consorts buried in attendance received seasonal sacrifices together within the hall.
translations.idiomatic: All consorts buried in attendance received seasonal sacrifices together within the hall.

sentences.zh: 其別葬金山諸處者，各遣內官行禮。

translations.literal: Those buried separately at Jinshan and other places each had inner eunuchs dispatched to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Those buried separately at Jinshan and other places each had inner eunuchs dispatched to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖間，始命併入諸陵，從祭祾恩殿之兩旁，以紅紙牌書曰：「某皇帝第幾妃之位」，祭畢，焚之。

translations.literal: During the Jiajing reign, they were first ordered merged into the various imperial tombs, with collateral sacrifice on both sides of the Hall of Ling'en Grace; red paper placards were inscribed saying "the place of such-and-such consort of such-and-such emperor," and after the sacrifice they were burned.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign, they were first ordered merged into the various imperial tombs, with collateral sacrifice on both sides of the Hall of Ling'en Grace; red paper placards were inscribed saying "the place of such-and-such consort of such-and-such emperor," and after the sacrifice they were burned.

sentences.zh: 後改用木刻名號。

translations.literal: Later carved wooden name plaques were used instead.
translations.idiomatic: Later carved wooden name plaques were used instead.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十三年，諭禮工二部：「世婦、御妻皆用九數。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Jiajing he instructed the Ministries of Rites and Works: "Palace women and imperial wives all use the number nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Jiajing he instructed the Ministries of Rites and Works: "Palace women and imperial wives all use the number nine.

sentences.zh: 九妃同一墓，共一享殿，爲定制。」

translations.literal: Nine consorts share one tomb and one Rest Hall; this is the fixed regulation."
translations.idiomatic: Nine consorts share one tomb and one Rest Hall; this is the fixed regulation."

sentences.zh: ○皇太子及妃喪葬

translations.literal: ○ Funeral Rites for the Crown Prince and Consort
translations.idiomatic: ○ Funeral Rites for the Crown Prince and Consort

sentences.zh: 自洪武中懿文太子後，至成化八年悼恭太子薨，年甫三歲。

translations.literal: From the Yiwen Crown Prince in the Hongwu reign onward, down to the eighth year of Chenghua when the Daogong Crown Prince died at only three years of age.
translations.idiomatic: From the Yiwen Crown Prince in the Hongwu reign onward, down to the eighth year of Chenghua when the Daogong Crown Prince died at only three years of age.

sentences.zh: 帝諭禮部，禮宜從簡，王府及文武官俱免進香帛。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed the Ministry of Rites that the ritual should be simplified and that princely establishments and civil and military officials were all exempt from presenting incense and silks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed the Ministry of Rites that the ritual should be simplified and that princely establishments and civil and military officials were all exempt from presenting incense and silks.

sentences.zh: 禮部具儀上。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites prepared the ritual and submitted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites prepared the ritual and submitted it.

sentences.zh: 自發喪次日，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: From the day after the mourning was announced, court was suspended for three days.
translations.idiomatic: From the day after the mourning was announced, court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 帝服翼善冠、素服，七日而除。

translations.literal: The Emperor wore the Yishan cap and plain dress for seven days, then dismissed mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore the Yishan cap and plain dress for seven days, then dismissed mourning.

sentences.zh: 又三日，御西角門視朝，不鳴鐘鼓，祭用素食。

translations.literal: After another three days he conducted court at the West Corner Gate; bells and drums were not sounded and sacrifices used vegetarian fare.
translations.idiomatic: After another three days he conducted court at the West Corner Gate; bells and drums were not sounded and sacrifices used vegetarian fare.

sentences.zh: 文武羣臣，素服、麻布、絰帶、麻鞋、布裹紗帽，詣思善門哭臨，一日而除。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials in plain dress, hemp cloth, mourning bands, hemp shoes, and cloth-wrapped gauze caps went to the Gate of Sishan Goodness for weeping attendance, and dismissed mourning after one day.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials in plain dress, hemp cloth, mourning bands, hemp shoes, and cloth-wrapped gauze caps went to the Gate of Sishan Goodness for weeping attendance, and dismissed mourning after one day.

sentences.zh: 第四日，素服朝西角門奉慰。

translations.literal: On the fourth day they attended court in plain dress at the West Corner Gate to perform the consolation rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day they attended court in plain dress at the West Corner Gate to perform the consolation rite.

sentences.zh: 在外王府並文武官，素服舉哀，二日而除。

translations.literal: Princely establishments outside the capital and civil and military officials wore plain dress and observed mourning, dismissing it after two days.
translations.idiomatic: Princely establishments outside the capital and civil and military officials wore plain dress and observed mourning, dismissing it after two days.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十八年，莊敬太子薨。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Jiajing the Zhuangjing Crown Prince died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Jiajing the Zhuangjing Crown Prince died.

sentences.zh: 禮部上喪禮。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites submitted the mourning ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites submitted the mourning ritual.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「天子絕期。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The Son of Heaven ends one-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The Son of Heaven ends one-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 況十五歲外方出三殤，朕服非禮，止輟朝十日。

translations.literal: Moreover, beyond fifteen years one has only just emerged from the third mourning grade; for me to wear mourning would be improper ritual—only suspend court for ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, beyond fifteen years one has only just emerged from the third mourning grade; for me to wear mourning would be improper—only suspend court for ten days.

sentences.zh: 百官如製成服，十二日而除。

translations.literal: All officials should assume full mourning according to regulation and dismiss it after twelve days.
translations.idiomatic: All officials should assume full mourning according to regulation and dismiss it after twelve days.

sentences.zh: 詣停柩所行，罷詣門哭臨。

translations.literal: They should go to the lying-in-state site to perform the rites; going to the gate for weeping attendance is abolished.
translations.idiomatic: They should go to the lying-in-state site to perform the rites; going to the gate for weeping attendance is abolished.

sentences.zh: 葬遣戚臣行禮。」

translations.literal: At burial, dispatch imperial kin ministers to perform the rites."
translations.idiomatic: At burial, dispatch imperial kin ministers to perform the rites."

sentences.zh: 萬曆四十七年二月，皇太子才人王氏薨，命視皇太子妃郭氏例。

translations.literal: In the second month of the forty-seventh year of Wanli, Talent Lady Wang of the crown prince died; he ordered that the precedent of Crown Princess Guo be followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the forty-seventh year of Wanli, Talent Lady Wang of the crown prince died; he ordered that the precedent of Crown Princess Guo be followed.

sentences.zh: 輟朝五日，不鳴鐘鼓。

translations.literal: Court was suspended for five days and bells and drums were not sounded.
translations.idiomatic: Court was suspended for five days and bells and drums were not sounded.

sentences.zh: 帝服淺淡色衣，百官青素服、黑角帶朝參，皇長孫主饋奠。

translations.literal: The Emperor wore light-colored garments; all officials wore blue-black plain dress with black horn belts to attend court; the eldest imperial grandson presided over the offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore light-colored garments; all officials wore blue-black plain dress with black horn belts when attending court; the eldest imperial grandson presided over the offerings.

sentences.zh: ○諸王及妃公主喪葬諸儀

translations.literal: ○ Funeral Rites for Princes, Consorts, and Princesses
translations.idiomatic: ○ Funeral Rites for Princes, Consorts, and Princesses

sentences.zh: 定制：親王喪，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: Fixed regulation: for the mourning of a prince of the blood, court was suspended for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed regulation: for the mourning of a prince of the blood, court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 禮部奏遣官掌行喪葬禮，翰林院撰祭文、諡冊文、壙志文，工部造銘旌，遣官造墳，欽天監官卜葬，國子監監生八名報訃各王府。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites memorialized dispatching officials to conduct the funeral rites; the Hanlin Academy composed the sacrificial text, posthumous charter, and tomb inscription; the Ministry of Works made the spirit banner; officials were dispatched to construct the tomb; officials of the Directorate of Astronomy divined the burial; and eight students of the Imperial Academy announced the death to each princely establishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites memorialized dispatching officials to conduct the funeral rites; the Hanlin Academy composed the sacrificial text, posthumous charter, and tomb inscription; the Ministry of Works made the spirit banner; officials were dispatched to construct the tomb; officials of the Directorate of Astronomy divined the burial; and eight students of the Imperial Academy announced the death to each princely establishment.

sentences.zh: 御祭一，皇太后、皇后、東宮各一，在京文武官各一。

translations.literal: One imperial sacrifice; the Empress Dowager, the Empress, and the Eastern Palace each one; civil and military officials in the capital each one.
translations.idiomatic: There was one imperial sacrifice; the Empress Dowager, the Empress, and the Eastern Palace each performed one; and every civil and military official in the capital performed one as well.

sentences.zh: 自初喪至除服，御祭凡十三壇，封內文武祭一。

translations.literal: From the initial mourning to dismissing the mourning garments, imperial sacrifices totaled thirteen altars; civil and military officials within the fief performed one sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: From the first day of mourning until the mourning garments were laid aside, there were thirteen imperial sacrifices in all; civil and military officials within the fief performed one sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其服制，王妃、世子、衆子及郡王、郡主，下至宮人，斬衰三年，封內文武官齊衰三日，哭臨五日而除。

translations.literal: As for mourning dress: the princess consort, the heir, sons of secondary wives, commandery princes, and commandery ladies, down to palace women, wore cut-edge hemp mourning for three years; civil and military officials within the fief wore hemmed hemp mourning for three days and attended weeping for five days before dismissing it.
translations.idiomatic: For mourning dress, the princess consort, the heir, sons of secondary wives, commandery princes, and commandery ladies, down to palace women, wore cut-edge hemp mourning for three years; civil and military officials within the fief wore hemmed hemp mourning for three days, attended the weeping rites for five days, and then laid the mourning aside.

sentences.zh: 在城軍民素服五日。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians within the city wore plain dress for five days.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians in the city wore plain dress for five days.

sentences.zh: 郡王、衆子、郡君，爲兄及伯叔父齊衰期年，郡王妃小功。

translations.literal: Commandery princes, sons of secondary wives, and commandery lords, mourning elder brothers and uncles, wore hemmed hemp mourning for one year; commandery princess consorts wore lesser hemp mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Commandery princes, sons of secondary wives, and commandery lords wore hemmed hemp mourning for one year when mourning elder brothers and uncles; commandery princess consorts wore lesser hemp mourning.

sentences.zh: 凡親王妃喪，御祭一罈，皇太后中宮、東宮、公主各祭一罈。

translations.literal: For mourning of an imperial prince's consort, there was one imperial sacrifice at one sacrificial altar; the Empress Dowager, the central palace, the Eastern Palace, and princesses each sacrificed at one altar.
translations.idiomatic: When an imperial prince's consort died, there was one imperial sacrifice at one altar; the Empress Dowager, the Empress, the Eastern Palace, and the princesses each performed one sacrifice at one altar.

sentences.zh: 布政司委官開壙合葬。

translations.literal: The provincial administration commission dispatched officials to open the tomb chamber for joint burial.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial administration commission dispatched officials to open the tomb chamber and conduct the joint burial.

sentences.zh: 繼妃、次妃祭禮同。

translations.literal: The sacrificial rites for a secondary consort and a junior consort were the same.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial rites for a secondary consort and a junior consort were the same.

sentences.zh: 其夫人則止御祭一罈。

translations.literal: For a lady of lower rank, there was only one imperial sacrifice at one altar.
translations.idiomatic: For a lady of lower rank, there was only one imperial sacrifice at one altar.

sentences.zh: 俱造壙祔葬。

translations.literal: All constructed tomb chambers for collateral burial.
translations.idiomatic: In every case a tomb chamber was built for collateral burial.

sentences.zh: 郡王喪，輟朝一日。

translations.literal: For the mourning of a commandery prince, court was suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: When a commandery prince died, court was suspended for one day.

sentences.zh: 行人司遣掌行喪葬禮，餘多與親王同，無皇太后、皇后祭。

translations.literal: The Envoy Office dispatched officials to conduct the funeral rites; most of the rest was the same as for an imperial prince, but without sacrifices by the Empress Dowager or the Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The Envoy Office dispatched officials to conduct the funeral rites; most other arrangements matched those for an imperial prince, except that there were no sacrifices by the Empress Dowager or the Empress.

sentences.zh: 郡王妃與親王妃同，無公主祭。

translations.literal: For a commandery princess consort it was the same as for an imperial prince's consort, but without sacrifices by princesses.
translations.idiomatic: The rites for a commandery princess consort were the same as for an imperial prince's consort, except that princesses did not perform sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 合葬郡王繼妃次妃喪禮，俱與正妃同。

translations.literal: The mourning rites for the secondary and junior consorts of a commandery prince buried jointly were all the same as for the principal consort.
translations.idiomatic: The mourning rites for the secondary and junior consorts of a commandery prince who were buried jointly with him were all the same as for the principal consort.

sentences.zh: 凡世子喪，御祭一，東宮祭一。

translations.literal: For mourning of an heir, there was one imperial sacrifice and one sacrifice by the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When an heir died, there was one imperial sacrifice and one performed by the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 遇七及百日、下葬、期年、除服，御祭各一。

translations.literal: At the forty-ninth-day observance, the hundred-day mark, burial, the one-year anniversary, and the dismissal of mourning garments, there was one imperial sacrifice at each.
translations.idiomatic: At the forty-ninth-day observance, the hundred-day mark, burial, the one-year anniversary, and the laying aside of mourning garments, there was one imperial sacrifice on each occasion.

sentences.zh: 凡世孫喪禮，如世子，減七七及大祥祭。

translations.literal: The mourning rites for an heir's son were like those for an heir, with the forty-nine-day mourning period and second-year anniversary sacrifices omitted.
translations.idiomatic: The mourning rites for an heir's son followed those for an heir, but omitted the sacrifices at the forty-nine-day mourning period and the second-year anniversary.

sentences.zh: 凡鎮國將軍，止聞喪、百日、下葬三祭，奉國將軍以下，御祭一。

translations.literal: For a State-pacifying General, there were only three sacrifices—at announcement of death, at the hundred-day mark, and at burial; for a State-supporting General and below, there was one imperial sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: For a State-pacifying General, there were only three sacrifices—at the announcement of death, at the hundred-day mark, and at burial; for a State-supporting General and those of lower rank, there was one imperial sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 正統十三年，定親王塋地五十畝，房十五間。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhengtong, the cemetery of an imperial prince was fixed at fifty mu with fifteen rooms.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Zhengtong, the cemetery allotted to an imperial prince was fixed at fifty mu with fifteen rooms.

sentences.zh: 郡王塋地三十畝，房九間。

translations.literal: A commandery prince's cemetery was thirty mu with nine rooms.
translations.idiomatic: A commandery prince's cemetery was thirty mu with nine rooms.

sentences.zh: 郡王子塋地二十畝，房三間，郡主、縣主塋地十畝，房三間。

translations.literal: The cemetery of a commandery prince's son was twenty mu with three rooms; that of a commandery lady or county lady was ten mu with three rooms.
translations.idiomatic: The cemetery of a commandery prince's son was twenty mu with three rooms; that of a commandery lady or county lady was ten mu with three rooms.

sentences.zh: 天順二年，禮部奏定，親王以下，依文武大臣例。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianshun, the Ministry of Rites memorialized a fixed regulation: for imperial princes and below, the precedent for civil and military ministers was to be followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianshun, the Ministry of Rites memorialized that for imperial princes and those of lower rank, the precedent established for civil and military ministers should be followed.

sentences.zh: 或王、或妃先故者，合造其壙。

translations.literal: Whichever of prince or consort died first, they jointly constructed the tomb chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Whichever of the prince or consort died first, a tomb chamber was jointly constructed for them.

sentences.zh: 後葬者，止令所在官司安葬。

translations.literal: For the one buried later, local officials were simply ordered to carry out the interment.
translations.idiomatic: For whichever spouse was buried later, the local authorities were simply ordered to carry out the interment.

sentences.zh: 繼妃則祔葬其旁，同一享堂。

translations.literal: A secondary consort was given collateral burial beside them, sharing one spirit hall.
translations.idiomatic: A secondary consort was given collateral burial beside them, sharing a single spirit hall.

sentences.zh: 成化八年二月，忻王見治薨。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year of Chenghua, Prince Xin, Jianzhi, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year of Chenghua, Prince Xin, Jianzhi, died.

sentences.zh: 發引日，帝不視朝。

translations.literal: On the day the funeral procession departed, the Emperor did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: On the day the funeral procession departed, the emperor did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 及葬，輟朝一日。

translations.literal: At burial, court was suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: At burial, court was suspended for one day.

sentences.zh: 十三年，四川按察使彭韶言：「親王郡王薨逝，皆遣官致祭，使臣絡繹，人夫勞擾。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Peng Shao, surveillance commissioner of Sichuan, said: "When imperial princes and commandery princes die, officials are dispatched to perform sacrifices; envoys come in unending succession, and laborers are troubled and harassed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Peng Shao, surveillance commissioner of Sichuan, said: "When imperial princes and commandery princes die, officials are dispatched to perform sacrifices; envoys arrive in an unending stream, and the laborers are worn down and harassed.

sentences.zh: 自後惟親王如舊，其郡王初喪遣官一祭，餘並遣本處官。

translations.literal: From now on only imperial princes would remain as before; for commandery princes at the initial mourning one official would be dispatched for one sacrifice, and for the rest local officials would be dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth only imperial princes would be treated as before; for commandery princes, one official would be dispatched for a single sacrifice at the initial mourning, and local officials would handle the rest.

sentences.zh: 凡王國母妃之喪，俱遣內官致祭。

translations.literal: For mourning of the queen and consorts of princely states, eunuchs were dispatched to perform sacrifices in every case.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the queen or a consort of a princely state died, eunuchs were dispatched to perform the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 今宗婦衆多，其地有鎮守太監者，宜遣行禮。

translations.literal: Now imperial clanswomen are numerous; where there is a resident grand eunuch, he should be dispatched to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clanswomen are now numerous; where a resident grand eunuch is posted, he should be dispatched to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 又王國塋葬，夫婦同穴。

translations.literal: Moreover, in princely state burials, husband and wife shared one grave.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in princely states husband and wife were buried in the same grave.

sentences.zh: 初造之時，遣官監修，開壙合葬，乞止命本處官司。

translations.literal: At the time of initial construction, officials were dispatched to supervise the work and open the tomb chamber for joint burial; he requested that only local officials be ordered to do this.
translations.idiomatic: At initial construction officials were dispatched to supervise the work and open the tomb chamber for joint burial; he asked that hereafter only the local authorities be ordered to handle it.

sentences.zh: 」帝從禮部覆奏，王妃祭禮如舊，餘依議行。

translations.literal: The Emperor followed the Ministry of Rites' resubmission: sacrificial rites for princess consorts remained as before, and the rest was carried out according to the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted the Ministry of Rites' resubmission: sacrificial rites for princess consorts remained unchanged, and the rest was carried out as proposed.

sentences.zh: 弘治十六年七月，申王祐楷薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixteenth year of Hongzhi, Prince Shen, Youkai, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixteenth year of Hongzhi, Prince Shen, Youkai, died.

sentences.zh: 禮部言：「前沂穆王薨，未出府。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites said: "Previously, when Prince Yimu of Yi died, he had not yet left the princely establishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites said: "Previously, when Prince Yimu of Yi died, he had not yet left the princely establishment.

sentences.zh: 申王已出府而未之國，擬依沂穆參以在外親王例行之。」

translations.literal: Prince Shen had left the establishment but had not yet gone to his fief; it was proposed to follow Prince Yimu, with reference to the precedent for imperial princes abroad."
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shen had left the establishment but had not yet departed for his fief; it was proposed to follow the precedent of Prince Yimu, with reference to the regulations for imperial princes residing outside the capital."

sentences.zh: 王妃葬地載於《會典》者，明初追封壽春等十王及妃，墳在鳳陽府西北二十五里白塔，設祠祭署、陵戶。

translations.literal: Princess consorts' burial grounds recorded in the Collected Statutes: in the early Ming, ten princes including Shouchun, posthumously enfeoffed, and their consorts had tombs at White Pagoda, twenty-five li northwest of Fengyang Prefecture; sacrificial bureaus and tomb households were established.
translations.idiomatic: The burial grounds of princess consorts recorded in the Collected Statutes show that in the early Ming, ten princes including Shouchun, enfeoffed posthumously, and their consorts were buried at White Pagoda, twenty-five li northwest of Fengyang Prefecture, where sacrificial bureaus and tomb households were established.

sentences.zh: 南昌等五王及妃祔葬鳳陽皇陵，有司歲時祭祀，皆與享。

translations.literal: Five princes including Nanchang and their consorts received collateral burial at the Fengyang imperial tombs; local officials performed seasonal sacrifices, and all partook in the offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Five princes including Nanchang and their consorts were given collateral burial at the Fengyang imperial tombs; local officials performed seasonal sacrifices at which all partook in the offerings.

sentences.zh: 懷獻世子以下諸王未之國者，多葬於西山，歲時遣內官行禮。

translations.literal: Princes below the Huai-xian heir who had not yet gone to their fiefs were mostly buried at the Western Hills; eunuchs were dispatched to perform seasonal rites.
translations.idiomatic: Princes below the Huai-xian heir who had never departed for their fiefs were mostly buried at the Western Hills, where eunuchs were dispatched to perform the seasonal rites.

sentences.zh: 永樂十五年正月，永安公主薨。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year of Yongle, Princess Yong'an died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year of Yongle, Princess Yong'an died.

sentences.zh: 時初舉張燈宴，遂罷之。

translations.literal: At the time the lantern-lighting feast had just begun, so it was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: The lantern-lighting feast had just begun, so it was cancelled.

sentences.zh: 輟朝四日，賜祭，命有司治喪葬。

translations.literal: Court was suspended for four days; sacrifices were granted; relevant offices were ordered to manage the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: Court was suspended for four days, sacrifices were granted, and the relevant offices were ordered to manage the funeral.

sentences.zh: 二月，太祖第八女福清公主薨，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: In the second month, the eighth daughter of Taizu, Princess Fuqing, died; court was suspended for three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Taizu's eighth daughter, Princess Fuqing, died, and court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 定制，凡公主喪聞，輟朝一日。

translations.literal: Fixed regulation: whenever news of a princess's death arrived, court was suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: By fixed regulation, whenever news of a princess's death arrived, court was suspended for one day.

sentences.zh: 自初喪至大祥，御祭凡十二壇。

translations.literal: From the initial mourning to the second-year anniversary, imperial sacrifices totaled twelve altars.
translations.idiomatic: From the first day of mourning to the second-year anniversary, there were twelve imperial sacrifices in all.

sentences.zh: 下葬，輟朝一日。

translations.literal: At burial, court was suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: At burial, court was suspended for one day.

sentences.zh: 儀視諸王稍殺，喪制同，惟各官不成服，其未下嫁葬西山者，歲時遣內官行禮。

translations.literal: The rites were slightly reduced compared with those for princes; the mourning dress was the same, but officials did not wear mourning garments; for those not yet married and buried at the Western Hills, eunuchs were dispatched to perform seasonal rites.
translations.idiomatic: The rites were somewhat reduced compared with those for princes, though the mourning dress was the same; officials did not wear mourning garments. For princesses who had not yet married and were buried at the Western Hills, eunuchs were dispatched to perform the seasonal rites.
